tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid ngo sprod dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na maḥshrī gu ra we/ na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel gyi lam gyis phyag rgya chen po cig car du gsal bar byed pa'i man ngag lam cha tshang du ston pa thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid kyi khrid yig nges pa'i don gyi snang ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang rang ngo bos stong ba'i chos rnams kun/ /yang yang chu zla lta bur legs gzigs nas/ /ngo bo ngo bo med pa'i chos gsung ba/ /dam pa dam pa'i mchog gyur bla mar 'dud/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i tshogs spangs shing / /snang dang snang med shes bya kun gzigs te/ /kun tu kun nas 'gro rnams brtse ba yi/ /thugs rje'i thugs kyis nye bar skyong la 'dud/ /mthu stobs mchog mnga' dpa' brtan gsang sngags 'dzin/ /nag po'i phyogs 'joms bstan pa skyong la brtson/ /rigs bzhi las skyes rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhis bsrung zhing rtag tu skyongs/ /rgyal bas e baṃ yi ges mtshan pa'i don/ /srid zhi dbyer med mi 'gyur phyag rgya che/ /bsgoms pa'i stobs zhan bdag blo'i yul min yang / /yang dag don la goms slad gsal bar bshad/ /de'ang theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems yin pas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral la thar pa'i bde ba bla na med pa la dgod par bya/ de'i don du gsang sngags lam cha tshang gi gdams pa gsan nas/ sgrub pa nyams su blang snyam pa sngon du btang ste gsan 'tshal/ 'dir bshad bya'i man ngag 'di nyid la yi dam gyi lha gcig gi sgrub thabs shes pas yi dam gyi lha thams cad kyi sgrub thabs shes pa'i man ngag ces kyang bya ste/

grub thob gnyan gyi zhal nas yi dam gyi lha gcig bsgrubs pas yi dam gyi lha thams cad kyi zhal mthong ba'i man ngag yin gsung / gang zag gcig dang po lam la zhugs nas/ mthar sangs ma rgyas kyi bar gyi lam tshang la ma nor ba cig ston pas lam cha tshang gi gdams ngag ces kyang bya/ 'di'i bskyed pa'i rim pa rang gang mos kyi yi dam la byas te bsgom du rung bas spyir yi dam thams cad kyi dmar khrid du 'gyur na'ang / khyad par du thugs rje chen po la sbyar nas ston pas bye brag tu thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid ces kyang bya ste/ grub thob kyi zhal nas 'o skol bod thams cad thugs rje chen po la mos shing khong gi gdul bya yin pas khong gi sgos mi dang 'dra ba'i phyir grub thag shin tu nye gsung / gang zag sdig po che shan pa ma ru rtse lta bu'ang gseb lam nas tshe gcig gam 'chi khar yun ring du ma bsgoms par yang btsan thabs su sangs rgya bas sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgya ba'am ma bsgoms par sangs rgya ba'i gdams pa zhes kyang bya ste/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs bzhi dang ldan pa'i gdams ngag ston pa la don gnyis te/ bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang / gdams ngag dngos so/ /dang po ni/ yid ches shing khungs btsun par bya ba'i phyir brgyud pa'i lo rgyus cung zad brjod na/ gdams ngag 'di yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsungs te gsang rgyud yin/ des grub thob gnyan la gsungs te gdung rus las mtshan du btags pa gnyan/ na bza' hrul po tshem bu 'ba' zhig byas pa gsol bas na na bza' las mtshan du btags pas grub thob tshem bu pa/ mtshan dos dar ma 'od ces grags shing / 'khrungs yul shab stod pa yin no/ /khong la chu mig gi sdog ston dkar mos ston mo lung phul nas 'gro don mdzad par zhus pas/ 'di lta bu 'dod pa gzhan na yod kyis gzhan la phul gsung nas ma bzhes par g.yas ru byang phyogs rta nag gi ri khrod kun tu sgrub pa mdzad nas grub pa thob pa'i dus su/

kho bo la sdog btsun dkar mos phye 'thor ma zug pa'i mi cig yin gsung / de la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs brjod kyis mi lang ba mnga' ba'i bla ma des gdams ngag 'di gnang ba mi drug las med de/ 'bring mtshams lcem lung gi rdzong logs pa'i dge bshes gcig rong yul la dgon pa'i btsun pa gcig dang gnyis la gnang nas 'bul ba yang lan gsum gsum tsam re byas gsung / khong rang gi dbon po dbang phyugs grags bya ba la gnang ste gang zag bzang po gcig byung gsung / de khong rang gi gcung po yin yang zer/ yang khong rang gi nye gnas lo bcu gnyis bcu gsum tsam mdzad pa'i jo sras phye brag pa bya ba gnang ste/ phyis grub pa thob nas grub thob phye brag pa zhes grags khong gis grub pa thob nas lho brag nas mar byon pas lho brag ras pa bya ba'i grags pa byung skad/ yang spyi bo lhas pa chen po la yang gnang ste/ mtshan byang chub 'od ces bya'o/ /khong la mdo bstan bcos la sogs pa'i mkhyen rab mang du mnga' zhing mdo rgyud man ngag du ma gzigs kyang chos thams cad gcig tu dril nas nyams su len ma mkhyen par jo shag la gsol ba 'debs su byon pas/ bla ma gnyan gyis snod ldan du mkhyen te lha sar byon pa dang mjal zhes kyang zer/ snga nas lha sar bzhugs pa dang mjal ba yin zhes zer te/ khong gis gnyan dang mjal ma thag grub thob tu mkhyen nas chos thams cad gcig tu dril nas nyams su len pa'i chos gcig zhu byas pas/ phyi mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i lam cha tshang bya ba rin spungs kyi don khrid du bya ba gcig dang / nang gsang sngags kyi lam cha tshang bya ba dmar khrid 'di gnyis gnang zhing byin gyis brlabs so/ /de phyir bcad chos thams cad gcig tu dril nas nyams su len/ mkhyen pa byung ste bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes pa yin skad/ sdog btsan dkar mo la yang chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor tsho gsungs zhes zer te slob ma drug po de thams cad la chos 'dis phan thogs shing grub pa thob pa byung bas gdams pa 'di la dog par mdzad de/

khong rnams kyis chos 'di'i brgyud pa 'dri mi dgos/ mkha' 'gro ma'i kha rlangs thul le ba'i chos yin/ khyed gzhan la bshad kyis snyam nas 'dug ste/ 'di gang dran dran la bshad rgyu'i chos min/ nyams su blang rgyu'i chos yin gsung nas brgyud pa 'dri ba la shin tu mi mnyes skad/ slob ma de rnams kyi nang nas spyi bo lhas pas stag sde brag dmar ba byang chub tshul khrims la gnang ste gang zag bzang po gcig byung zer/ des lha btsun dgon sar ba la gnang ste byang chub sems dpa' chen po gcig byung gsung / de la kun spangs pas zhus so/ /yang lugs gcig la/ grub thob phye brag pas stag ston spyil phu ba la gnang / de dang kun spangs pa gsang phu ne'u thog tu byon pa mjal te chos kyi gsung gleng mang du mdzad cing / thugs dam gyi mthil gang la mdzad dris pas/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid la mdzad gsung nas zhus pas gnang ba yin gsung / bla ma 'di'i zhal nas man ngag 'di shin tu bka' gnyan par 'dug nas jo shag gi drung du gsol ba mang du btab/ khyad par du bcu gcig zhal gyi drung du gsol ba mang du btab pas bka' mi gnyan du song nas gzhan la'ang bstan du 'dod cing phan thogs par byung gsung / 'di'i mtshan thugs rje brtson 'grus zhes bya la/ bzhugs gnas kyi mthil/ 'o dong gi sa'i cha jo me nang zhes kun la grags pa de yin zhing / yon tan gyi khyad par phyi mtshan nyid theg pa la lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa gtso bo ston pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa mngon pa dang / de'i phyogs su gtogs pa mngon sum dang rjes su dpag pa rnam pa gnyis kyis chos thams cad kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs shing gzhal bya'i gnas gsum gsal bar ston pa'i rtog ge'i bstan bcos mtha' dag dang / nang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel gyis lam ston pa'i rgyud sde mtha' dag dang /

de'i man ngag sna tshogs la thugs kyi snang ba rgyas shing / khyad par bde stong gnyis su med pa'i lam ston pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus rgyud/ phyi ma'i rgyud/ bskyed rdzogs kyi cha lag mtha' dag la mnga' brnyes nas bsams na shes pa'i mngon par shes pa la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan mtha' dag dang ldan pas snyigs ma'i gdul bya rnams kyi 'dren pa dam par gyur pa yin no/ /des bla ma dam pa brag kha ba grags pa seng ge zhes bya ba dang / yongs su 'dzin pa chen po rin chen dpal bzang po zhes bya ba la gdams so/ /snga ma'i yon tan gyi khyad par yang grub mtha' gnyis dang / rgyud sde bzhi dang / khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rgyud sde du ma'i man ngag la mnga' brnyes pas sbyor ba yan lag drug dang / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i man ngag bdud kyi gcod dang / rnal 'byor pa'i lam zab la cha tshang ba 'di nyid dang / gzer lnga'i man ngag ste bzhi po de dag la thugs dam gyi gtso bor mdzad nas gdul bya'i khams dang bag la nyal dang / 'tsham par chos ston zhing / phyi gdon gyi bar chad/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs/ nang ting nge 'dzin sems kyi gegs rnams sel ba la mkhas pa'i phul du 'byung la/ dka' thub bcud len gyi sgo nas bdag gzhan zas gos kyi sdug bsngal dang bral bar byed cing / 'khor ba'i longs spyod dmyal ba'i me dang 'dra bar gzigs nas rgyal ba'i yon tan gcig tu bde ba'i bdag nyid du dgongs te bde ba chen po'i lam la bcos ma ma yin par gshegs shing 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba yin no/ /phyi ma'i yon tan yang bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub kyi sems dang ldan zhing chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar gzigs la/ sdom pa rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis rgyud phyug par mdzad de/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang / rtog ge'i bstan bcos lta spyod gtso bor ston pa'i dbu ma rigs tshogs/ spyod 'jug

bslab bsdus la sogs pa dang / nang pa dgyes pa rdo rje/ bde mchog dus 'khor la sogs pa'i rgyud dang / de dag gi man ngag bka' gdams lugs dang / phyag rgya chen po'i skor/ gcod/ zhi byed/ rdzogs chen/ sbyor drug rim lnga la sogs pa zab pa dang / rgya che ba'i pha rol du son zhing / mngon par shes pa dang / bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin pa'i rtags dang ldan pa dang / bstan pa la zhugs pa dang / ma zhugs pa'i gdul bya mang po'i don mdzad nas/ thugs mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang las ma g.yos par ngo mtshar ba'i rtags du ma dang bcas te zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan zhing / de nyid la rtse gcig tu mos shing dad pa dang ldan pa rnams la 'di nyid dang gzhan du bde ba phun sum tshogs pa stsol bar mdzad par yid ches shing sku tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags ma thag pa'am/ bar do la sogs pa ring por mi thogs par phyag rgya chen po mngon du mdzad pa la ni the tshom med do/ /'di dag la ni rang nyid kyi mos pa tsam ma yin pa yid ches pa'i rgyu mtshan mang du yod de bri bar ma spobs so/ /bdag gi bla ma mtha' yas mkhyen brtse'i mdzod/ /bdag la lung rtogs yon tan stsol mdzad cing / /rnam pa kun tu brtse bas legs bskyangs pas/ /bdag gi 'dren pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de lta bu'i dam pa gnyis kyi thugs kyi rgya mtsho las gdams ngag 'di nyid dang / gzhan dang gzhan zab cing rgya che la rin thang tshad med pa'i man ngag gi nor bu gnang zhing / gsung gi bdud rtsis blo gros kyi lce'i dbang po tshim par mdzad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gdams ngag dngos la gnyis/ stan thog gcig tu bsgom pa'i man ngag nyams su blang tshul dang / de las gzhan pa'i man ngag nyams su blang ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la sbyor ba thun mong gi sngon 'gro bzhi 'brel pa can du bsgom pa dang / dngos gzhi bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim zung 'brel du bsgom pa dang /

rjes bsngo ba dang smon lam zung 'brel du nyams su blang ba gsum gyi/ dang po la rgyud snod du rung bar byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ sdig sgrib dag par byed pa yi ge brgya pa/ tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal/ byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid bzhi'i dang po la gnyis/ tha mal pa dang lam log pa las khyad par du byed pa skyabs 'gro dang / lam dman pa nyan rang las khyad par du byed pa sems bskyed do/ /dang po la lnga las/ skyabs su 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bdag gzhan sdug bsngal gyi dgra bos rtag tu gzir bas bskyab dgos pa dang / de las skyob pa'i dpung gnyen dkon mchog gsum ma gtogs pa gzhan su'ang med cing / gsum kho nas skyob nus pa dang / skyel mas sha 'khon gyi 'jigs pa las skyob pa ltar rang gi dad pa drag pos skyabs su song na skyob mi skyob the tshom mi za ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i rten bsam pa ni/ mdun phyogs kyi rten gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri'i steng du shin tu yangs shing mdzes pa'i pad zla brtsegs pa'i gdan khri sna tshogs la/ dbus su sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can dang / de'i phyi skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma/ de'i phyi skor du yi dam gyi lha/ de'i phyi rim du sangs rgyas dang byang sems/ de'i phyi rim du nyan rang / de'i phyir chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyis bskor bar dmigs so/ /gsum pa tshul ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du dkon mchog gsum la 'phral phugs kyi ltos pa thams cad lings kyi dor te/ mgo bcad phang bskyur dang / sna thag lings bskyur gyi tshul gyis/ dus da nas bzung ste sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du bla ma la 'dren pa/ yi dam la rgyud byin gyis rlob pa/ sangs rgyas la ston pa/

chos la lam/ dge 'dun la lam sgrub pa'i grogs/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la srung ma zhu snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsams te/ ngag tu bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la/ dam pa'i chos rnams la/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan can rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes kun la sbyar zhing ji tsam mi skyo'i bar du skyabs 'gro bya/ mjug tu bla ma yi dam dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dus 'di nas bzung nas sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du/ sems rgyud la chos min gyi rnam rtog gi 'gyur ba gang yang mi 'byung bar chos rnams kyi gnas lugs phyin ci ma log pa mngon du 'gyur zhing gzungs thob par/ lam gyi snying po thabs shes zung 'jug gi rtogs pa khyad par can da lta nyid du rgyud la skye bar/ gnas skabs su lam gyi bar chad mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi bar/ mthar thug don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo/ /zhes snying gi dkyil rkang gi khong / rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba gdab bo/ /bzhi pa skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya ni/ skyabs gzhan mi tshol/ ci la thug kyang skyabs gsum mi spang / skyabs su song ba'i phan yon dran pas yang yang skyabs 'gro la goms par bya'o/ /lnga pa phan yon la gnyis las/ thun mong gi phan yon/ sangs rgyas bar chud/ dge ba thams cad kyi rten du grub/ nyes pa thams cad las skyob par 'gyur ba'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i phan yon/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su song bas sangs rgyas bdag gi ston pa dang / bdag nyid myur du sangs rgyas par 'gyur/ chos la skyabs su song bas chos bdag gi lam du 'gyur zhing /

bdag nyid kyang chos zab mo myur du ston par 'gyur/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song bas dge 'dun gyis bdag gi grogs mdzad cing / bdag nyid kyang myur dge 'dun gyi tshogs sdud par 'gyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed pa la lnga las/ dang po sems bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad drin can gyi pha ma yin pas drin lan glan dgos shing / de thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyus dbyen bcos la/ de las sgrol ba'i nus pa sangs rgyas ma gtogs pa su la'ang med pas/ bdag kyang sangs ma rgyas na sdug bsngal rgyu bcas las skyob pa'i nus pa med la/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo byang chub kyi sems yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed blang ba'i yul ni sngar bzhin no/ /gsum pa tshul ji ltar bskyed pa ni/ khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du lam cha tshang gi gdams ngag nyams su blang la sems can gyi don ci nus kyis bsgrub cing / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya rnams la bslab snyam pa'i bsam pas/ bla ma yi dam lhar bcas dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gzhan don slad byang chub bar/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la'ang / /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyis smon 'jug gi sems bskyed do/ /bzhi pa sems bskyed pa'i bslab bya ni gsum ste/ sems de nyid gzhan don du bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan blo la bzhag nas/ dngos dang brgyud pas ci nus kyis sems can la phan 'dogs pa dang / de'i don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan blo la bzhag nas/

byang chub chen po thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa drag pos rang nyid lam bsgrub pa la brtson pa dang / gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon blo la bzhag nas sems de nyid la yang yang goms par byed pa'o/ /de la bla ma gnyan gyi zhal nas/ de lta bu'i bsam sbyor 'jug pa gcig pa'i byang chub kyi sems snga dro yod na snga dro dang / gung la yod na gung / phyi dro yod na phyi dro/ rtag tu yod na rtag tu byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma yin pa ye med na rgyal sras kyi ming mi thob gsung ngo / /lnga pa phan yon la gnyis te/ thun mong gi phan yon/ theg pa chen po'i lam du tshud pa dang / dge ba rgya chen po 'phel zhing mi zad pa dang / srid zhi'i nyes pa thams cad las skyob par 'gyur ba'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i phan yon/ gzhan don du sems bskyed pas sems can gyi mgon khyad par can du 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas su sems bskyed pa'i sangs ma rgyas bar du bsam sbyor mi zad pa dang / bar ma dor chud zos par mi 'gyur ba dang / gzhan don dang sangs rgyas thob 'dod gnyis ka dang ldan pa'i 'dun pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyus myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par nges pa'o/ /gnyis pa sdig sgrib dag par byed pa yi ge brgya pa la lnga'i/ dang po yig brgya zla dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal ba'ang sdig sgrib bsags pa las byung ba yin zhing / sangs rgyas thob pa la'ang sgrib gnyis spang dgos la/ de spong ba'i thabs kyang rdo rje sems dpa'i bzlas sgom 'di nyid mchog tu bsngags te tshegs chung la phan yon che ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa lha bsgom pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhu ba las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/

gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐ bsam/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sangs rgyas thams cad gnyis su med par bstims la/ de la bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyang du gsol ba btab pas/ yab yum gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i zla ba'i steng gi rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gi yi ge sngags kyis phreng bas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ thugs bskul bas snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'o ma lta bu byung / yab yum gyi tshangs bug nas zhugs sku gang ste thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang sku'i cha shas las 'dzag pa rang gi tshangs bug nas byon/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon thams cad rnag khrag gam dud khu'i rnam pas bshang gci'i sgo dang / rkang lag gi sor mo ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'thon/ lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang ba la yid gtad de/ gsum pa sngags bzlas pa ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka te no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍidho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sar+b+ba sidhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan/ he ru ka ma me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas pa'i rjes su/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pas te/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes dang / sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes ltung gi tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod do/ /bzhi pa de kho na nyid bsgom pa ni/

mdun gyi bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras bcas rnams 'od du zhu/ rdor sems yab yum la thim/ de 'od du zhu bdag gi spyo bo nas thim pas lus 'od kyis khengs/ las nyon las byung ba'i rnam smin gyi lus sha khrag la sogs pa dag nas sbrul shun pa brjes pa ltar/ rdor sems chu zla lta bu snang la rang bzhin med pa'i skur gyur par bsams pa'i ngang la blo gnas tshad du bzhag go /lnga pa rjes bsngo ba ni/ de las ma g.yos bzhin du/ bdag gi dge ba 'di la brten nas bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib dag nas sangs rgyas par gyur cig snyam pa'i 'dun pas/ bdag gi dge ba 'di yis ni/ /sems can gcig kyang ma lus par/ /sdig pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /rtag tu dge ba spyod par shog /ces brjod do/ /gsum pa tshogs rdzogs pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid la lnga las/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sangs rgyas thob pa la bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs dgos shing / de'i thabs kyang maṇ+ṭal dbul ba nyid mchog yin te/ rgyu chung la phar phyin drug rdzogs par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gang la 'bul ba'i yul ni/ skyabs 'gro'i rten bsam pa dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa ji ltar 'bul ba'i tshul ni/ rang gi 'byor ba dang bstun pa'i maṇ+ḍal sa rdo shing rin po che las byas pa de nyid/ rgyu bdag gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i sgo gsum gyi dge tshogs las grub pa/ rgya stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams dang mnyam pa/ phyi lcags ri chen po gcig gis bskor bar dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas 'og thams cad gser gyi sa gzhir bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i ba'i lci ba chu dang bcas pas khye ma med par byug cing / oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbus su me tog gcig gzhag go /de nas dbus dang g.yas skor gyi phyogs bzhi dang / de dag gi g.yas g.yon dang /

nang gi ri rab dang gling gi phyogs mtshams su shar dang me nas brtsams nas me tog gi tshom bu re bzhag cing / gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ rin po che sna bdun dang gter chen por mos te/ oṃ haṃ ma hā me ra be na maḥ.oṃ yaṃ pūrba bi de hā ya na maḥ oṃ raṃ dzam+bu dwi pa na maḥ oṃ khaṃ a pa ra go dā nī ye na maḥ oṃ baṃ utā ra ka ra be na maḥ zhes dang / oṃ a u pa dwi pā ya na maḥ oṃ ra u pa dwi pā ya na maḥ oṃ la u pa dwi pā ya na maḥ oṃ ba u pa dwi pā ya na maḥ zhes pa lan gnyis dang / oṃ ya ga dza rat+na ya na maḥ oṃ ya ga dza rat+nā ya na maḥ oṃ pu ru ṣa rat+nā ya na maḥ oṃ la a shwa rat+nā ya na maḥ oṃ ba hasti rat+nā ya na maḥ oṃ ya khaḍ+ga rat+na na maḥ oṃ ra tsa kra rat+nā ya na maḥ oṃ la ma hā ma ṇi rat+nā ya na maḥ oṃ ba ma hā ni dhi rat+nā ya na maḥ zhes dang ཿ ri rgyal gyi mdun dang rgyab tu tshom bu re bzhag pa nyi ma dang zla bar mos te/ oṃ sūr+yā ya na maḥ oṃ tsan+d+rā ya na maḥ zhes snyog med rdo rjes mdzad pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga ltar ram/ yang na tshom bu bdun mar byas te/ dbus su ri bo mchog rab/ shar lus 'phags/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma dang zla ba/ dbus su rin chen bdun/ bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad/ gter chen po'i bum pa la sogs pa lha dang mi'i 'dod pa'i yon tan ma tshang ba med pa sa gzhi dang nam mkha' thams cad khengs pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu dmigs nas/ chos rje pas mdzad pa'i tshig zhing khams rnam par dag pa 'di/ /dbus kyi ri rgyal ri rab la/ /gling bzhi 'dod yon lnga yis brgyan/ /nyi ma zla ba skor ba byed/ /lha mi'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /rgyal srid rin chen rnam pa bdun/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang dpag bsam shing / /ma rmos lo thog gser dang dngul/ /'bru bzang longs spyod bsam mi khyab/ /dngos po bzang la gya nom pa/ /bla ma sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul/

/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing / ji srid mi skyo'i bar du dbul lo/ /bzhi pa mjug gi bya ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i rjes su 'dod pa'i don gang yin pa grub par gsol ba gdab cing / dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs te/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba/ /dam pa gnyis ni thob par shog /ces bsngos nas/ tshogs rten dang maṇ+ḍal badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ lnga pa phan yon ni/ ba yi lci ba chur bcas sbyin pa ste/ /legs par byug par byed pa tshul khrims so/ /srin dang grog sbur bsal ba bzod pa yin/ /bya ba la ni nyer zhugs brtson 'grus te/ /de la skad cig sems ni gcig byed pa/ /bsam gtan shes rab ri mo gsal ba'o/ /thub pa'i maṇ+ḍal byas pa yis/ /pha rol phyin pa 'di drug thob/ /gser gyi mdog tu 'gyur ba ste/ /nad rnams kun dang bral bar 'gyur/ /zla ba ltar mdzes gsal ba yis/ /lha dang mi ni dam par skye/ /nor dang gser ni 'byor ba yi/ /rgyal po'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i pho brang mchog /maṇ+ḍal gang zhig byed pa dang / /sdig pa thams cad mi byed cing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / /rang gi sems ni yongs 'dul ba/ /'di dag sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags/ /zhes dgra las rgyal bas gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho gar drangs pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa byin rlabs 'jug pa bla ma'i rnam 'byor gyi khrid la lnga las/ dang po bla ma la gsol ba gdab dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ tshe 'di phyi'i bde skyid dang mchog thun mong gi dngos grub 'grub pa'i rten 'brel gsang sngags pas bla ma la brten nas sgrig dgos pas/ rgyud la byin rlabs ma zhugs pa 'jug cing / zhugs pa mi nyams shing 'phel bar byed pa la bla ma la mos gus byed dgos la/ de'ang mos gus che na byin rlabs che/

'bring na 'bring / tha ma na tha ma las mi 'byung bas/ sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes na sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs 'jug pa nas tha ma'i bar du bsgres pa 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis par bla ma bsgom pa'i tshul dngos ni/ rang gi smin mtshams gyi thad kar rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo/ sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje g.yon dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la mnyam par bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam/ dkon mchog gsum sprin phung gtibs pa ltar spyan drangs la rtsa ba'i bla ma dbyer med du thim par bsgom/ gsum pa tshul ji ltar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma de nyid dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo/ bla ma kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i bde skyid thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin nges snyam du bsams la/ mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod/ dgra gnyen dang bar ma lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad ltos pa med par phul bar mos te/ don dran bzhin pas/ /bla ma rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma rnams la bdag skyabs mchi/ /bdag ni khyod la rnam kun 'bul/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /dam chos 'khor lo mchog bskor dang / /yongs su mya ngan 'da' yang phyir/ /bdag ni khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /'di sogs dge ba'i las rnams ni/ /byang chub bla na med par bsngo/ /zhes yan lag bdun sngon du 'gro bas mchog thun mong gi don du gsol ba drag tu gdab bo/ /bzhi pa lta ba bskyang ba ni/ bla ma de nyid dgyes bzhin par rang gi spyi bor byon 'od du zhu/ tshangs bug nas thim ste/ rang gi sgo gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur par bsams te mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang la sgo gsum ma bcos pa'i tshul gyis rang lugs su gzung 'dzin gyi dri mas dben par blo gnas tshad du bzhag cing /

rjes su bsngo bas rgyas btab la/ spyod lam thams cad du lta ba de dran par bya zhing bskyang ngo / /lnga pa bslab bya ni/ bla ma la lus phul ba yin pas/ bla ma'i bya ba bsgrub dgos te/ bla ma'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang gzhan don yin pas sgo gsum de la 'dud cing / lus kyis bla ma'i zhabs tog ci 'grub 'grub/ longs spyod phul ba yin pas/ longs spyod bla ma dkon mchog gi phyogs dang gzhan don du gtang / dgra gnyen bar ma dge rtsa thams cad bla ma la phul ba yin pas chags sdang ci byas kyang / bla ma'i rdzas la brnab sems dang gnod sems su 'gyur ba'i phyir su la yang ma chags shing sdang ba med pa la bslab bo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim zung 'brel du bsgom pa la gnyis las/ zung 'brel du bsgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rdo rje 'chang gis kyang / rim pa gnyis la ma brten par rgyud gang yang ma gsungs shing / gnyis kho na la brten nas gsungs pa'i phyir dang / lam snga ma snga ma la ma brten par phyi ma phyi ma bsgom mi nus pa'i phyir dang / sbyang gzhi sems can gyi sems rgyud kyang gsal stong zung 'jug yin pa'i phyir dang / de sbyong byed kyi lam thams cad kyang zung 'jug tu nyams su ma blangs na zhen pa mi spong zhing / 'bras bu sku gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i sangs rgyas mngon du bya dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag rim pa ltar/ kye rdo rjer/ bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid dang ni/ /rdzogs pa yi yang rim pa nyid/ /rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas ni/ /rdo rje can gyi chos 'chad do/ /zhes dang / rim pa lnga par/ klu'i blo'i zhabs kyis kyang / /bskyed pa'i rim pa legs gnas te/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /lam ni skas kyi rim bzhin gsungs/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa brgyad stong pa las kyang / sems ni sems ma mchis te/ sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o/

/zhes dang / dus kyi 'khor lor yang / rnal 'byor thabs kyi skus ma yin/ /shes rab gcig pus yang ma yin/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rnal 'byor gsungs/ /zhes dang / kye rdo rje las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /brtul zhugs can gyis spros pa bsgom/ /spros pa rmi lam ltar byas nas/ /spros pa nyid ni spros med byed/ /ces dang / e ma byang chub sems dpa' che/ /dad pa'i shugs kyis rab tu nyams/ /lus kyi dngos med gang la bde/ /bde ba smra bar mi nus so/ /zhes gsungs shing / ye shes grub pa las/ lha dang sngags ni rnal 'byor pas/ rgyud las gsungs pa kun tu bya/ /gang la mnyam pa'i sems yod pa/ /de la ye shes skye 'gyur gyi/ /gzhan du bskal pa bye ba ni/ /brgyas kyang thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur du/ phyag na rdo rjes gsol ba/ lus can sgom pa'i thabs kyi dgos pa ci lags/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' bstsal pa/ dgos pa yod do/ /de ci lags/ sangs rgyas nyid do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa tshul ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul la/ thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom tshul dang / shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom tshul gnyis kyi dang po la bcu las/ dang po sgra don ni/ lha rten dang brten pa'i rnam pa blos bskyed pas na bskyed pa/ mngon par byang chub la sogs pa'i rim pas rim gyis gsal 'debs pas na rim pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa dgos pa ci'i don du bsgom pa ni/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog spang ba dang / 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi rten byed pa dang / mthar gzugs sku 'grub pa'i don du bsgom pa ste/ gur du/ phal pa'i gnas skabs gzhom pa'i phyir/ /bsgom pa yang dag rab tu grags/ /zhes dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel chen las kyang / 'jig rten pa'i bden pa ni dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam par rtog pa bsgom pa 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/

/zhes dang / 'jig rten pa'i kun rdzob bstan pa de ni phyi dang nang bcas pas 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i phyir/ gang rang gi sems kyis yongs su brtags pa'i chos de 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub kyi 'bras bu/ ster bar byed pa zhes dang / gur du/ sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni mngon par 'grub/ /ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/ /de dag thabs kyi gzugs can no/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa gnas gang du bsgom pa ni/ dad pa can gyi gnas yid dang mthun pa'i dgon par skye bos dben pa dang / sbyangs pa can gyi gnas ri khrod dang / rtogs pa can gyi gnas dur khrod la sogs pa ste/ kye rdo rjer/ dang po gos par byed dus kyi/ /gnas ni gang du bsngags pa'i sems/ /gcig tu mnyam bzhag 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /gnas ni bzang po nges par brtag /ces dang / gur du/ snying rje chen po kye rdo rje/ /dang ni dur khrod chu 'gram dang / /nags tshal chen po'i nang dag tu/ bsnyen bkur can la dngos grub ster/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa gang gis sgrub pa'i gang zag ni/ mchog gsum la dad cing snying rje dang ldan pa dbang bskur ba legs par thob pa dgos te/ gsang ba grub par/ shes rab dad pa yang dag ldan/ /skye bo rnams la snying rjer ldan/ /khro ba med cing bslu ba med/ /gtong sogs yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ /spro chen rang gi brtson 'grus ldan/ /rtag tu bla ma'i bka' bzhin byed/ /ma sgo yang ni rang gi blos/ /yo byad la sogs dngos po rnams/ /ji snyed pa dang ci nus dang / /de bzhin bza' dang bca' sogs dbul/ /ji ltar brnyas par gyur yang ni/ /yid ni zhum pa med par bzod/ /lung dang rigs pa rtogs pa'o/ /slob ma yon tan kun ldan yin/ /zhes dang / phyag rgya chen po thig ler/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin/ /zhes so/

/lnga pa bsgom pa'i dus ni/ las dang pos mtshan dus dang / brtan pa thob pas thun gsum la sogs pa dang / brtan pa cher thob pas rgyun chad med par bsgom ste/ dgyes pa'i rdo rjer/ mtshan dus su zhes dang / thun gsum du bsgom pa rnam par bsgom nas zhes dang / gur du/ rtag par shin du sngags bzlas shing / /zhes so/ /drug pa bsgom pa'i yan lag la gsum gyi dang po/ las dang po pas mngon byang lnga dang sbyar te bsgom pa ni/ kun spangs chos rje'i zhal nas/ gzhan gyi mngon byang lnga dang / 'di'i mngon byang lnga bsgom tshul cung zad mi 'dra gsung la/ de'ang sngon 'gro'i yan lag rnams tshang bar byas pa'i rjes su/ rang nyid pad ma'i sdong po'i steng na yod pa'i snying khong stong du bsgoms te/ de ni dang po'i stong pa nyid las byang chub pa zhes bya'o/ /de'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba lta bu bsgom pa ni gdan pad zla las byang chub pa zhes bya'o/ /zla ba'i steng du hriḥyig dkar po gcig bsams te gsung yig 'bru las byang chub pa'o/ /hriḥlas 'od 'phros te rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad khengs pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang / sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin las grub pa'i sha khrag rus pa la sogs pa'i tshogs ma dag pa'i lus kyi phung po dag nas 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur par bsgom pa ni thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa'o/ /pad zla phyag mtshan thams cad 'od kyi gong bur zhu/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid yi dam thugs rje chen po sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ dbu skra phyed thor lcog tu byas shing phyed sil bur 'phyang ba/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pa na shel phreng /

g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma dkar po snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba bsnams pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ se mo do/ sku rags la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang / dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i skur gyur par bsgom pa ni sku yongs su rdzogs pa las byang chub pa'o/ /de nas rang gi thugs ka'i pad zla'i steng du yi ge hriḥdakar po gcig bsgom/ de las 'od 'phros phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad la phog pas ma dag pa'i dri ma thams cad bkrus 'od du zhu/ de yongs su gyur pa las rin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa/ phyi nas bltas na nang gsal ba/ nang nas bltas na phyi gsal ba/ rkang pa btegs na phar byed pa/ mnan na nem byed pa/ de lta bur gyur par bsgom ste/ de la bla ma gnyan gyi zhal nas/ 'o skol gsang sngags pa'i lugs kyis gnas gang na 'dug kyang gzhal yas khang bya ba yin/ 'di lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas nas/ 'dug sa sa phug brag phug la sogs par 'dug kyang / gzhal yas khang du bsgoms pas nam zhig sangs rgyas dus na zhing khams rnam par dag pa 'thob pa'i rgyu yin gsung / yang 'od 'phros nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas tha na lus kyi srin bu'i bar thams cad kyang thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur par bsgom/ de la bla ma gnyan gyi zhal nas/ gsang sngags pa'i lugs kyis grogs su dang 'grogs kyang yi dam lha zhes pa yin/ 'di lta bu'i rnal 'byor la gnas nas tha na dud 'gro dang 'grogs kyang yi dam lhar bsgoms pas nam zhig sangs rgyas dus 'khor yongs su dag pa thob pa'i rgyu yin gsung / yang hṛḥlas 'od 'phros yi dam lha dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas rdo tshan la kha ba 'bab pa ltar gnyis su med par thim pas/ rang yi dam kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du bsam/ de la bla ma gnyan gyi zhal nas/ tshe 'di la grub pa thob par byed pa la 'di lta bu'i blo stobs gcig dgos pa yin te/ yi dam gyi lha gcig la yi dam thams cad 'dus par bsgoms pas/ yi dam gyi lha thams cad kyi zhal myur du mthong zhing dngos grub 'byung ba yin gyi/ 'ga' zhig lha yang sgom yang bshig mang po byed par 'dug ste/ de la zhal mthong dus kyang mi 'byung la dngos grub kyang mi 'byung ste/ yi dam lha la 'dor len du song ba yin gsung / khong rang sku gshegs khar yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs pa yin skad/ yang hṛḥlas 'od 'phros rang gi tshangs bug nas 'thon te rtsa ba'i bla ma yang bzhugs pa nas spyan drangs/ sku 'das nas mi bzhugs na 'og min nas spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs te/ bum pa'i chus rang la dbang bskur/ chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang / sdig sgrib dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bo'i gtsug tu nyi zla pad+ma'i dar gyi lhab lhub gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med kyi rnam par bzhugs par bsam/ de nas bla ma'i thugs ka dang rang gi snying ka'i hriḥlas 'od 'phros brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / rang gi chos 'brel yod tshad kyi bla ma rnams spyan drangs te/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la gnyis su med par thim pas/ bla ma kun 'dus su bsam/ de la chos rje kun spangs kyi zhal nas/ res 'ga' rang gang mi mos pa de spyi bor bsgoms la/ de la gang mos pa'i bla ma thams cad bstim/ res 'ga' mos pa de spyi bor bsgoms la/ mi mos pa thams cad de la bstims la/ bla ma thams cad la mnyam nyid du mos gus bya'o gsung / gnyan gyi zhal nas tshe 'di la grub pa thob pa la blo stobs 'di lta bu gcig dgos te/ bla ma gcig la bla ma thams cad 'dus par bsgoms te mos gus byas pas byin rlabs myur du 'byung ba yin gyi/

'ga' zhig bla ma yang bsgom yang bshig mang po byed par 'dug ste/ bla ma la 'dor len byed pa la byin rlabs mi 'byung gsung / de nas thugs kar pad+ma zla'i steng du hriḥdakar po la yi ge drug gis bskor ba la klog pa'i tshul du bsam zhing sngags bzlas so/ /de'ang rang rkyang par ma zad/ spyi bo'i bla ma kun 'dus dang / yi dam thams cad dang / mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad lhar bsgoms pa dang / tha na lus kyi srin bu lhar bsgoms pa yan chad bzlas pa'i grogs byed par bsams la bzlas so/ /de'ang brjod pa dang pos thugs ka'i hriḥl ma ṇi'i bskor bar bskyed/ gnyis pas gsal gdab/ gsum pa phan chad sgra grags stong rang bzhin med par bsams te bzlas so/ /de la gnyan gyi zhal nas/ da lta phal gcig sngags rdog gcig bgrang phreng rdog gcig bskyur zhing bzlas pa byed de/ de lta bus bsnyen pa 'khyol dus mi 'ong / tshe gcig la sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la 'di lta bu'i blo stobs gcig dgos pa yin/ 'di lta bu'i bzlas pa byed pa ni dpag tu med pa'am tshad med par 'gyur ba'i bsnyen pa yin gsung / khong rang phreng ba la hab bskyur mdzad cing de lta bu'i steng nas thugs dam mdzad pa lags skad do/ /kun spangs chos rje'i zhal nas kyang / sems kyis zin par gyur na sngags 'di lta bu la lan re bgrangs pa la'ang bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'byung gsung / gnyis pa goms pas skad cig dran rdzogs su bsgom pa ni/ de lta bu'i bskyed rim la brtan pa thob nas skad cig la mngon byang lngas lha gsal btab pa nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i bar du yid ma g.yengs par rtse gcig pa'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'o/ /gsum pa 'khyer so gsum gyis mjug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar snod gzhal yas khang dang / bcud lha'i rang bzhin du snang la rang bzhin med par shes pa ni snang ba sku'i 'khyer so yin la/ sgra grags pa thams cad snying po sngags kyi rang sgra grags stong du shes pa ni grags pa gsung gi 'khyer so yin zhing /

sems kyi dran rtog ci byung thams cad rig stong lha'i thugs kyi rang bzhin du shes pa ni dran pa thugs kyi 'khyer so yin no/ /de lta bu'i 'khyer so gsum dang ma bral bzhin du mnyam rjes thams cad la rgyas btab nas bsgom pa nyid gnad du che'o/ /bdun pa sems zin pa'i rtags ni/ rab la lha'i phyag mang pos dngos su don byed nus pa dang / 'bring la gzhan gyis kyang lhar snang ba dang / tha mas tha mal pa'i rnam rtog spong ba'o/ /brgyad pa bogs dbyung ba ni/ de ltar bsgoms pas las dang po pas lha sku la sems ma zin na/ dang po lha'i sa bon rkyang pa la sems bzung / de la sems zin nas phyag mtshan/ de la zin nas gtso bo rkyang pa la/ de la zin nas spyi bo'i bla ma la/ de la zin nas bcud lhar gyur pa thams cad dang / gzhal yas khang gi bar la rim pas bslab cing / lha'i sku yang thog mar rags pa dang phra ba dang phra ba'i phra ba'i bar la rim pas sems 'dzin pa la bslab par bya'o/ /dgu pa de nyid la lam 'bras kyi chos thams cad tshang bar ngo sprad pa ni/ kun rdzob tu lha sku sgyu ma lta bu la don dam par chos sku'i rang bzhin du bsgoms pas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug dang bden pa gnyis kyang tshang zhing / dngos po la lha'i rnam pa mi gnas kyang blos btags nas bsgoms pas kun btags de ltar btags nas bsgoms pas myang 'das kyi lam du 'gro bas gzhan dbang / gang gi ngo bor yang grub pa med par bsgoms pas yongs grub bo/ /de nyid kyi gnas skabs mthar thug gi gnod pa las skyob pas skyabs 'gro/ don des sems nyid spros pa dang bral bar byed pas sangs rgyas rjes dran/ de'ang sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms pas chos thams cad kyi rten du gyur pas chos rjes dran/ lha'i 'khor lo la dmigs pa gtad pas lha rjes dran no/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs bsog pas tshogs lam/ swa bhā was sems tsam du shes pas sbyor lam/ shūn+ya tās stong pa nyid du shes pas mthong lam/

rten gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa bskyed nas sgom pas sgom lam/ 'khor lo bsdus nas mi dmigs pa mthar phyin pa'i lam mo/ /rang rgyud la lha sku rang chas su yod pa rgyu'i rgyud/ lam dus su lha ngo sprad nas sgom pas thabs rgyud/ de mngon du gyur pas 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /tshogs gsog pa dang / go bgo ba dang / spro bsdu la sogs pa thams cad sprul sku/ lha zhen pa dang bral ba la dmigs pa gtod pa longs sku/ de'ang rang bzhin med pa chos sku/ des na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad bsgom par 'gyur bar shes par bya'o/ /bcu pa phan yon ni/ gnas skabs su lha'i rnam par bsgoms pa'i ming dang brda dang tha snyad la brten nas rang gi sems kyi nyer len gyi rgyu dang cho gas rkyen byas nas rang gi sems nyid lha'i rnam par snang zhing de la rnal 'byor pa'i sems gnas par byed pa dang / de la goms pas snang srid thams cad rten dang brten pa sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin du shes nas rgyud la zhe sdang mi skye zhing / mi snang ba dang / mang po gcig dang / gcig mang por sprul ba la sogs pa lus kyi rdzu 'phrul cung zad ston par nus la/ sgo gsum lha sngags mi rtog pa'i rang bzhin yin pa la yin par shes nas ye shes rgyud la skye zhing / des sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la mngon du byas shing bsgoms pas sgro 'dogs nang nas chod pa zhes bya la/ des sa brgyad pa mngon du byed par slob dpon klu'i blos bzhed cing / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang / a bha yas kyang sa bdun mngon du byed par bzhed do/ /mthar thug gzugs sku gnyis 'grub par sngar lung dang bcas nas bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pas bsgom pa la bcu las/ dang po sgra don ni/ yul chos nyid dang yul can ye shes gnyis med du sgom pa ni rdzogs pa yin la/ de bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas sems gnas pa'i thabs kyi rim pas gsal 'debs pas na rim pa'o/

/gnyis pa dbye ba la gnyis te/ mtshan ma dang bcas pa dang / mtshan ma med pa'o/ /de la dang po ni/ bar gyi dbang gnyis dang 'brel ba ste/ dbang dus su ye shes ngo sprad nas/ lam dus de bsgoms pas 'bras bu'i dus su longs sku'i kha sbyor mngon du byed pa'o/ /'di lta bu'i grol bas bgrod pa'i lam 'di ni gzhi spong bas bgrod pas pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa pa dang / sangs rgyas 'dod par mnyam yang sgrub lugs mi 'dra ste/ so nam dang tshong bzhin no/ /de bzhin du gnyis kas nyon mongs spong bar 'dra yang / spong ba'i thabs ni khyad par mi 'dra ste/ dper na dug sman dang sngags kyis gsod pa lta bu'o/ /des na 'di ni thabs kyis khyad par du 'phags te/ dug la sngags kyis btab pas sman gyi mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / rgya mtsho la nor bu rin po che lon pas dgos 'dod thams cad dus gcig la 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de la bla ma'i man ngag med pa rgyus med pa'i lam mkhan lta bu dang / slob ma rgyud ma dag pa dbul po'i sgyed pu gser la byas pa ngo ma shes pa lta bu dang / dbang gi dus ma shes pa sman pas nad ngo ma shes pa lta bu dang / thabs khyad par can gyis ma zin pa skom pa la me byin pa lta bu spangs la/ dbang po rnon pos bla ma'i man ngag la brtson par bya dgos te/ klu'i blo'i zhabs kyis kyang / 'ga' zhig ri dbang rtse nas lhung gyur na/ /lhung bar mi 'gyur snyam yang lhung bar 'gyur/ /bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob na/ /grol bar mi 'gyur snyam yang grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni dbang bzhi'i dus su bla mas nus pa ji lta bar slob ma'i rgyud la bskyed pa'i bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin bag chags thams cad dang bral bas nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can don dam pa'i bden pa ste/ dgongs pa bla na med pa las/ /rig pa tsam gyis ye shes ni/ /nam mkha' 'dra bar mtshan nyid med/ /ces so/ /de'i ming gi rnam grangs kyang /

spyod bsdus las/ 'od gsal ba dang / thams cad stong pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang / rdo rje'i ye shes dang / bla na med pa la sogs pa nas nyon mongs pa zad par byed pa zhes bya ba'i bar du dgu bcu go gsum gsungs so/ /gsum pa dgos ni/ thabs dman pa dang spros pa'i rnam rtog spong ba dang / phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob pa dang / mthar thug chos sku sgrub pa'i don du ste/ dus 'khor 'grel chen las/ 'khor ba'i bde ba mi rtag pa/ /de 'tshol 'dod pa rmongs chen po/ /rgyal po chen po'i bde thob kyang / /mthar phyin mkhas pas yang dag spang / /zhes dang / slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong gi ni cho gas ni/ /lus kyi de nyid mi shes pa/ /de dag thams cad 'bras bu med/ /ces dang / sa ra has kyang / snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang / /des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no/ /'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgoms na yang / /'khor ba 'di las thar ba yod dam ci/ /gang yang gnyis po sbyor bar nus pa des/ /'khor bar mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa yang / saṃ ṭar/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung byed yin/ /mi rtog ting nge 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dus 'khor 'grel chen du/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa ste/ rnam pa thams cad du zhal dang phyag dang kha dog dang dbyibs kyi rnam par rtog pa dang bral ba'o/ /zhes dang / gsum pa yang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bden pa ni du ba la sogs pa'i mtshan mas rnam par mi rtog pa'i sems rdzogs pa'i rim pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub bsgrubs pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / bzhi pa yang / saṃ bu ṭar/ rang byung ngo bo nyid 'di ni/ /chos kyi skur ni rab tu grags/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa gnas gang du bsgom pa ni/

mdo rgyan du/ blo ldan gang du sgrub pa'i yul/ /legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang dang / /sa bzang ba dang grogs bzang dang / /rnal 'byor bde ba'i yon tan ldan/ /zhes pa ltar mthun rkyen tshegs chung ngus rnyed/ chom rkun la sogs pa mi 'byung / gnas la brten pa'i chu sogs kyis nad mi 'byung / lta spyod mthun pa'i gang zag yod/ zhi lhag la nyin par skye bo'i 'du 'dzis mi gnod/ ljan ljin med/ mtshan mo dgra mi 'byung ba'i gnas sam/ dus 'khor 'grel chen du/ gang du sa skyong chos ldan dang / /sa 'dzin gzhan dang g.yul med pa'i/ /sems can gang dag bder gnas par/ /der ni rnal 'byor yang dag brtsam/ /zhes pa ltar/ mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan pa'i gnas su/ 'dul ba dang / dus 'khor las 'byung ba ltar/ dben khang mtho sar brtsigs la/ sgo 'khyog rim pa gsum pa'am/ 'dzul sgo can/ sgom dus snang ba 'byung ba'i bug pa cung zad kyang med par gtams pa'i nang du mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor dang / ri'i rtse mo'am/ thang yangs po'am/ khang bzang mthon po'i steng / gzhan gyis tshur mi mthong zhing / phar nam mkha' yangs pa mthong ba'i gnas su nyin mo'i rnal 'byor las dang po pas bya ba yin te/ snyan rgyud du/ mtshan mo bla gab bcas pa ru/ nam mkha' la dmigs stong nyid bsgom/ zhes dang / snying po gsal ba las/ chu 'dzin dang ni bral ba yi/ /nam mkha' dwangs par gyur pa la/ /rtse gcig mi rtog bsgom par bya/ /phyi dro yang ni de bzhin no/ /nyin phyed mig la gnod phyir spang / /zhes dang / brgyad stong pa las/ ko'u shi kas smras pa/ 'phags pa rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du bslab par 'dod pas gang la bslab par bgyi/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ ko'u shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du 'dod pas nam mkha' la rnal 'byor du bslab par bya'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la rnal 'byor du bslab par 'dod pa des bla gab med pa la rnal 'byor du bslab par bya'o/

/zhes so/ /brtan pa thob pa'i gnas ni/ dur khrod dang chu 'gram la sogs pa ste/ dgyes pa'i rdo rjer/ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ma mo'i khyim dang mtshan mo dang / /yang na dben pa'am bas mtha' ru/ /sgom pa bzang por brjod par bya/ /zhes so/ /brtan pa cher thob pa'i gnas ni/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs par nges par med par bsgom ste/ gsang ba grub par/ grong dang grod khyer dag tu'am/ /sems ni gang du dga' ba de/ /der ni rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad/ /dgag pa dang ni sgrub pa med/ /ces so/ /lnga pa gang gis sgrub pa'i gang zag ni/ dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa dman pa'i 'tsho ba yongs su spangs pa lus longs spyod dang 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub la 'dod pa dang bral ba ltos med bzhi dang ldan zhing tshig don gyi sgro 'dogs bcad nas gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa ste/ snying po gsal ba las/ dbang gis smin byas dam tshig ldan/ /de la rnal 'byor gsum bstan te/ /gzhan la nam yang ma yin no/ /zhes dang / dus 'khor 'grel chen du/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa des/ bla ma dam pa la gdams ngag thob nas grogs ngan pa yongs su spangs te las dang po pas du ba la sogs pa'i mtshan ma bsgom zhing / dbu ma sbyang ba ni/ sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa bzhin du mchog tu brtse ba'i sems dang ldan pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bden pa la brten nas/ bu dang chung ma la sogs pa dang / rang gi lus la ltos pa med pas mchod rten dang / lha khang la sogs pa dang bla ma'i rdzas la longs spyod pa spangs te sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i lam la brten nas/ byams pa dang snying rje dang / dga' ba dang btang snyoms dang tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi la gnas pas zhi ba la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub par 'dod pa spangs nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la bgrod par 'dod pas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la sogs pa rnam par rtog pa sgom pa yongs su spangs pa dang /

nam mkha'i khams ltar thams cad stong pa me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin skye ba med pa'i chos bltas nas/ rang gi sems spros pa'i snang ba rmi lam gyi don dang 'dra bar sems kyi rdul phra mo'i tshogs kyi bdag nyid rnam par dpyad pas stong pa ni chad pa'i stong pa nyid las ring du gyur pa/ nang gi bdag nyid kyi bde ba rang rig pa'i chos la rjes su chags pa'o/ /zhes dang / yang lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa dang / ngag gi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa dang / yid kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa dang / 'dzag pa'i bde ba la ltos pa med pa ni bsnyen par de lus ngag yid tshangs par spyod pa'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i don to/ /'di dag gis lha'i mchog ster ba yin gyis srid pa'i longs spyod la zhen pas ni ma yin no/ /drug pa nam sgrub pa'i dus ni/ las dang po pas g.yas pa sa rlung rgyu ba'i dus nas mgo bzung ste bsgom la/ srod dang / tho rangs/ nyin gung / nam gung rnams rgod pa dang bying ba'i dbang du song nas ye shes 'jig pas dus de rnams bor la/ snga dro phyi dro dang mtshan mo'i nam stod smad kyi cha la bsgom ste/ snyan rgyud las/ g.yas pa sa'i rlung dus bsgom/ /zhes dang / srod dang tho rangs gung la min/ /zhes dang / nam mkha' la blta snga dro phyi/ /nyi zer nyi ma gung la min/ /zhes gsungs shing / lam 'bras pa'i lugs kyis/ rlung sna bug g.yon nas rgyu ba'i dus su lam bstan zhing bsgom pa la gnad du che ste/ nyams skye bul yang skyes pa brtan zhing bar chad chung la/ g.yas nas rgyu ba'i dus su bsgoms na nyams myur du skye yang mi brtan zhing bar chad 'byung la/ gnyis ka nas rgyu ba'i tshe'ang rlung 'phro mtshams yin pas de'i tshe'ang ting nge 'dzin gsha' ma mi skye bas bsgom pa'i dus ma yin par bzhed do/ /brtan pa thob pas nyin mtshan med par mnyam par bzhag ste/ brtag gnyis las/ chu bo'i rgyun ni rab 'bab dang /

/mar me'i rtse mo rab bcings ltar/ /rtag tu de nyid rnal 'byor gyis/ /nyin dang mtshan du mnyam par bzhag /ces so/ /brtan pa cher thob pas mnyam bzhag kho nar ma zad 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug la sogs pa'i spyod lam thams cad du mi 'bral bar nyams su len te/ dgyes pa'i rdo rjer/ bza' dang btung dang blugs pa dang / /nyal dang log dang sems pa na/ /phyag rgya chen po mngon 'dod pas/ /de nas mngon du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /bdun pa bsgom pa'i yan lag la/ ji ltar bsgom pa'i man ngag dngos dang / de nyams su blangs pas thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin ngo sprad pa/ bsgoms pas 'bras bu mngon du byed tshul gsum gyi dang po la mnyam bzhag tu lus ngag yid gsum ma bcos par bzhag pa dang / rjes thob tu ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po la gsum gyi lus mi g.yo bar bzhag pa ni/ rkang pa skyil krung lag pa mnyam bzhag gam/ rlung dbu mar 'jug pa'i phyag rgya'am/ sa gnon gang bde/ sgal tshigs bsrang / rgya mtsho ri la sbyar/ ro 'dzin rang gnas su 'phang / mgrin pa cung zad gug par bya/ mig mtho gang tsam gyis mdun gyi nam mkha' la blta zhing / bya byed thams cad dang bral ba rang lugs su 'jog pa'o/ /de la dgos pa ci yod na/ lus gnad dang po la brten nas ro rkyang gnyis kyi kha dbu ma la 'dud de/ la gsum 'dus pa cha'i dbyibs lta bu 'byung / de las rtsa g.yas g.yon gyi rlung dbu mar rim gyis tshud par 'gyur bas gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rags pa mi rgyu zhing lus cha snyoms pas lus bde ste 'dug tshugs pa dang / mthar thug chos thams cad 'gro 'ong med pa mtshon pa'o/ /lus gnad gnyis pas lus g.yas g.yon du mi g.yo bas lus bde zhing sems las su rung / khyad par du rlung dbu mar 'jug pa'i phyag rgyas gdon gyi bar chod 'gog ste/ srin lag gi rtsa ba la 'dre'i rtsa yod pas so/ /mnyam bzhag sa gnon gyis yan lag gi rlung rtsa ba'i rlung la 'jug cing /

de stobs kyis sems ji ltar 'dod par hril gnas pa dang / mthar thug chos nyid bya byed dang bral ba mtshon pa'o/ /lus gnad gsum pa'i dgos pa ni/ dgye dgug med pa'i lus sems bde la/ mdun rgyab tu gug zhing 'gyed song na mdun rgyab gnyis na zhing ting nge 'dzin gnyis bying rgod du 'gyur/ mthar thug chos thams cad 'khor 'das la mi gnas pa'i gnyug ma'i ye shes mtshon pa'o/ /lus gnad bzhi pa'i dgos pa ni/ g.yas g.yon gyi rlung dbu mas 'jib pa lta bu 'byung ste/ rlung dbu ma'i mar sna nas chud pas lte bar drod skye/ khams je brtan la song bas ting nge 'dzin skye/ mthar thug chos thams cad bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du mtshon pa'o/ /lus gnad lnga pas ni/ dbugs kha nas mi rgyu bas kha mi bskam zhing mchil ma mi bog thig le 'dzin/ mthar thug chos nyid brjod du med pa mtshon pa'o/ /lus gnad drug pas ni/ mgrin pa 'gyed gug tu song na/ lkog 'bras dang mgrin pa'i rgyab tu zug 'byung la/ mgrin pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa g.yas g.yon mnan pas rlung dbu mar tshud pa dang / mthar thug chos nyid gzung 'dzin dang bral ba mtshon pa'o/ /lus gnad bdun pas/ mig la rnam rtog gi rtsa yod pas 'gul na rnam rtog sna tshogs 'byung ba las/ mi 'gul bas shes pa yul la mi 'phro/ thig le 'ching / bying ba'i skyon sel mthar thug yul yul can gnyis su med pa mtshon no/ /dus zhabs snyan rgyud las/ 'bol ba'i stan la byed pa ni/ /lus bsrang rdo rje skyil krung bca'/ /lce bzlog gsus sbyar mig gyen bzlog /gtsug tor bsgyur ba'i lta stangs so/ /lag gnyis rdo rje bsdam par bya/ /des ni rlung rnams 'ching byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /lus gnad 'di lta bu nges par bya dgos te/ ting nge 'dzin sems kyis bsgom zhing sems rlung la brten/ rlung rtsa la brten/ rtsa lus la brten pas so/ /'byongs na gang ltar byas kyang rung ngo zhes so/

/gnyis pa ngag mi g.yo bar bzhag pa ni/ rlung g.yas g.yon gnyis gang nas rgyu bltas la/ rgyu ba'i phyogs nas rlung dal la rdzogs par phyir lan gsum btang / de bzhin du mi rgyu ba'i phyogs nas kyang lan gsum/ gnyis ka nas kyang lan gsum btang nas/ gzhi la ma bcos par bsdam pa rang sor 'jog pa'o/ /de'i dgos pa/ rlung ro gcig gis rlung thams cad skyon can du byed pas de je dwangs su gyur pas rlung zug mi 'byung ba'o/ /gsum pa yid ma bcos par bzhag pa la gsum/ sems kyi gzhi rtsa bcad pa/ sems kyi bzhag thabs bstan pa/ sems kyi bying rgod bsal ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī dza ga ta mi tra'i zhal nas/ thog ma bar dang mthar rim bzhin/ /rtsa ba ngo bo bye bral ba/ /rmi lam gyis ni mar me bzhin/ /zhes dang mnyam sbyor las/ e ma sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skye ba med/ /skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes tsam nyid na skye ba med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems nyid dang po gang nas byung / /bar du gang na gnas/ tha ma gang du 'gro brtags pas/ dper na sgyu ma'i rta glang 'dra bar dang po gang nas kyang ma skyes shing / rgyu rkyen gang gis kyang ma bskyed pas ye stong rtsa bral gcig tu 'dug /bar du rang gi ngo bo mo gsham gyi bu ltar bden par med de/ dbyibs dang kha dog tu ma grub pas 'gyu ba stong 'gyus/ snang ba stong snang du 'dug mthar 'gag pa med cing byed pa thams cad dang bral te/ 'gyu ba rang sangs gcig tu 'dug de nyid ka rnam thar sgo gsum gyi ngo bo yang yin te/ shrī dza ga tam mi tras/ 'gro 'ong gnas ni skye gnas dag /rnam rtog stong pa nyid rnam gsum/ /zhes pa ltar/ dang po skye ba med pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med pa/ bar du gnas pa med pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / tha ma 'gag pa med pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa med pa'o/

/des na sems nyid 'di dang po ma skyes pas tha ma rkyen gyis mi 'jig dus glo bur du ma byung bas gang stong 'phel 'grib med/ snang srid kun la khyab pas phyogs ris su ma chad/ dngos po dang mtshan mar ma grub pas 'di'o zhes mtshon du med/ cis kyang ma 'gag cir yang ma grub pas yod med rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das/ dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pas skye shi la gsal 'grib med/ rang bzhin ye nas dag pas 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas yin te/ kye rdo rje las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces so/ /de nyid thams cad kyi rang bzhin yang yin te/ mdo las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam mo zhes so/ /de ltar blos legs par gzhal te/ chos thams cad sems/ sems stong par blo thag bcad do/ /gnyis pa sems kyi bzhag thabs bstan pa ni/ slob dpon bram ze chen pos/ gang la zhen pa yod na de yang thong / /rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te/ /de las gzhan zhig su yang shes mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ glang chen lam nas sems tshags tshud pa bzhin/ /'gro 'ong bcad na nga yis dal ba ste/ /'di lta rtogs so nga la chos ci dgos/ /zhes pa ltar dang por sems kyis sems la nang du bltas te dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i shes pa gang yin brtags la/ 'das pa dang 'brel ba yin na 'das pa'i shes pa rjes mi bcad ces dran par bya/ ma 'ongs pa yin na sngun mi bsu bar dran/ da ltar gyi shes pa yin na thug phrad du rang bzhin med par dran par bya ste/ dus gsum gyi spros pa bcad nas byung tshor gang gi yang rjes su mi 'brang zhing blo yul gyi mtshan mas ma g.yengs par/ khong lhod kyis glod nas sems gsal na gsal stong / rig na rig stong dbyer med kyi ngang las phyi nang gi yul gang la'ang dmigs pa mi gtad par sems lhod de shig ge bzhag pas gnyug ma'i shes pa gsal le hrig ge ba 'byung ste/

de la bzo mi byed par blo gnas tshad du 'jog pa'o/ /de nyid la sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba dang bral zhing ma byas par tshim pas bde chen dang / gang du'ang ma 'gags pas sgrib pa'i rtsa ba dang bral zhing ma byas par tshim pas bde chen dang / gang du'ang ma 'gags pas sgrib pa'i rtsa ba dang bral zhing ma bsgrubs par dwangs pas 'od gsal dang / cir yang mi 'dzin la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba dang bral zhing ma bcos par shar bas rnam par mi rtog pa ste/ shrī dza ga ta mi tras/ bde chen 'od gsal rnam mi rtog /blo bzang rnams kyis mnyam par bzhag /ces so/ /de ni ma g.yengs par bzhag pa ral skor mkhan g.yul du zhugs pa lta bu'i man ngag ces bya ste/ de ni mdor/ sems 'jog par byed ces dang / mdo rgyan du/ dmigs pa la ni sems gtad nas/ /de rgyun rnam par g.yeng mi bya/ /zhes pa'i don yin no/ /de la sems mi gnas na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo las/ kun tu 'jog par byed/ nges par 'jog par byed/ nye bar 'jog par byed/ 'dul bar byed/ zhi bar byed/ nye bar zhi bar byed/ rgyud gcig tu byed/ mnyam par 'jog par byed/ ces pa'i don/ 'phags pa byams pas/ rnam g.yeng myur du rtogs byas nas/ /de la slar ni glan par bya/ /blo ldan gong nas gong du yang / /sems ni nang du bsdu bar bya/ /de nas yon tan mthong ba'i phyir/ /ting nge 'dzin la sems 'dul lo/ /rnam g.yeng nyes pa mthong ba'i phyir/ /de la mi dga' zhi bar bya/ /brnab sems yid mi bde la sogs/ /langs pa de bzhin zhi bar bya/ /de nas sdom brtson can gyis ni/ /sems la mngon par 'du byed bcas/ /rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba 'thob/ /ces pa ltar/ sngar gyi ting nge 'dzin de'i rgyun las shes pa yul la 'phro na rtog pa rgyun mi 'thud par 'das pa'i rjes mi bcad pa la sogs pa dran par byas nas/ sems spros bral gyi ngang du blang nas 'jog pa'o/ /de ltar ma zad 'gyus pa'i rtog pa kho na nyid la kho rang gi gcer bltas pas chu zla ltar bcings grol gang yang med par snang stong du lhag gis song ba de ka'i ngang la lus sems ma bcos par sngar ltar bzhag ste/

de nyid ngal sor/ bu nyon khyod gang rnam par rtog /'dir bdag ma bcings ma grol phyir/ /ma g.yengs ma bcos rang dgar ni/ /kye ho dub pa ngal gso zhig /ces so/ /gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan dran par byas nas bying rgod 'dul zhing / nyon mongs rnam rtog gis nyes pa dran par byas nas/ ting nge 'dzin la mi dga' ba'i skyon bsal lo/ /gdams ngag brjod nas brnab sems la sogs pa'i nyon mongs rnam rtog 'phro na sngar gyi man ngag dran pa tsam gyis zhi bar byas pas sems la 'bad rtsol yod pa de srid du ting nge 'dzin rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba 'thob ste/ de ni bar du ma bcos par rdzi bo mkhas pa glang po che skyong ba lta bu'i man ngag go /de ltar sems la bcos bslad med pa de'i nyams dang ma bral ba bzhin du rnam rtog sna tshogs kyi steng du blo chams kyis btang bas rnam rtog gang shar thams cad kyi ngo bo spros bral du lhag song nas thams cad mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'ba' zhig tu rang gis gnyen po la ma ltos par 'gro ba 'byung ste/ de ni mthar ci dgar bzhag pa gzings thog nas bya 'phur ba lta bu'i man ngag go /gsum pa sems kyi bying rgod bsal ba la gnyis las/ dang po bying ba bsal ba ni/ bying ba la dbye na/ ched du byas pa'i bying ba/ rkyen gyis bying ba/ rang shugs kyis byung ba'i bying ba dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ mal stan la sogs pa'i bde ba la zhen pas byung ba yin/ gnyis pa ni/ ha cang kha zas bcud ches pa dang / chang mang ba dang / lus ngal dub la sogs pa'i rkyen las byung ba yin la/ de dag ngo shes par byas la rkyen de dag zhag grangs ci rigs par spangs pas sel lo/ /gsum pa ni/ snga ma gnyis bsal yang ngang gis 'byung ba ste/ de'ang thun stod la byung na bsam gtan gyi gegs yin pas/ spyod lam stan mtho sar bsdad/ des ma sel na sa mtho sar bsdad/ mig ri thang mtshams su blta/ lus sems hur chung la bsgom/

bsam gtan gyi sngon rol gyi zas bcag yid kyis rang gi snying ga dran par byas la/ de nas rim gyis smin mtshams/ tshangs bug spyi bo'i steng gi sor bzhi nas brtsams te/ mthar steng gi nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i bar du shes pa 'phangs la gtang / yun ring na shes pa ma bde zhing snying rlung la sogs par 'gyur bas slar mar rim gyis phab la snying kha dran par byas la bzhag pas sel lo/ /thun sman la bying na khams kyi skyon yin pas/ thun bskyungs pa nyid kyis sel lo/ /gnyis pa rgod pa bsal ba ni/ rgod pa la dbye na/ ched du byas pa'i dang / rkyen gyis dang / rang shugs kyis rgod pa dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ kha smras la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi bya ba don du gnyer ba las byung la/ gnyis pa ni/ nyin mo mi sna tshogs kyi 'du 'tshogs mang ba dang / mtshan mo sgra gleng cor gyi rkyen byas pa las 'byung ngo / /de gnyis ngo shes par byas te rkyen de dag gzhan zhag grangs ci rigs par spangs pa nyid kyis sel lo/ /gsum pa ni/ skyon snga ma gnyis bsal yang rang shugs kyis 'byung ba ste/ de'ang thun stod la byung na bsam gtan gyi gegs yin pas/ de bsal ba ni/ spyod lam sa dma' sar bsdad/ kos kos brang gnon pa ltar bya/ mun pa la bsdad/ bsam gtan la 'jug khar kha zas cung zad dang / chang tsha skyur med pa snod che chung ci rigs pa gang btang / gom pa lnga bcur bcag des ma zhi na btung ba dang bcag pa stabs su bsten/ nad gzhi na tshod nam zla dang sbyar la bza' btung yang nyams sad cing btang ngo / /sems kyi gnad bshang lam du/ chos 'byung dmar po gcig bsam/ de'i nang na mar sems kyis blta/ de nas rim gyi sa gzhi dang / rgya mtsho rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas brtsams te 'og gi nam mkha'i mtha' ji srid par shes pa gtad thun 'jog tsa na snying kar dran par bya/ des sel/ des kyang ma zhi na rgod pa ngos bzung / de nas lan gcig 'phros lan gnyis 'phros zhes rgod pa'i grangs yid kyis bzung /

yul gang la 'phros pa'i yul de nyid la blos dmigs pa gtad cing bsgoms pas sel/ khyad par du rnam rtog mang ba la rdo rje'i bzlas pa byas pas 'phral du zhi bar 'gyur te/ de yang ngal gsor/ rta mchog dal bus 'gro 'ong la/ /gnas nang du ma gcig tu bya/ /zhes pa ltar rlung 'byung 'jug la yid gtad de/ phyir 'gro ba oṃ dkar po/ nang du 'jug pa āḥdamar po/ nang du gnas pa hūm̐ sngon por bsam ste/ rlung 'byung 'jug gnyis gcig tu byas pa/ gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du bgrang / yang yi ge rnams la ma brten par rlung 'byung 'jug gi grangs la yid gtad de bzlas pa'ang rung ngo / /de gnyis ka'i mthar yi ge dang grangs la shes pa mi gtad par dmigs med kyi ngang du glod cing bzhag go /de bzhin du drug cu rtsa lnga/ brgyad cu rtsa lnga/ brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du bgrangs pas sems gnas pa 'byung ste/ sems gnas pa'i tshad/ gang la gtad pa'i dmigs pa de 'byung gi gzhan mi 'byung ba dang / dus nam 'dod kyi tshe 'byung ba dang / yun ji srid 'dod pa'i bar 'byung ba yin pa la rtags ni lus 'dar ba dang / 'phar ba dang / g.yo 'gul med pa la sogs pa 'byung zhing / de'ang gsal cha che na/ snang ba dkar dmar gsal le ba 'byung ba dang / nyi ma dang zla ba dang mar me'i 'od lta bu'i nyams dang / shes pa yang ba la sogs pa 'byung / gnas cha che na byings se/ mun 'thibs se ba dang / blta snying mi 'dod pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo / /de ltar na long pa rkang pa can lta bu'i rlung nang du gnas pa na/ 'phye bo mig can lta bu'i rlung nang du gnas pa na/ 'phye bo mig can lta bu'i sems ngang gis gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de lta ma yin na/ sems kyi skyes bu rlung gi rta la bzhon nas yul sdug mi sdug la sogs par rgyu bas chags sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa skyes te lus ngag yid gsum gyi las bsags nas 'khor bar sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong bar 'gyur bas/

thog mar rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du bsal ba gal che'o/ /thun smad la bying na khams kyi skyon yin pas thun bskyungs pa nyid kyis sel lo/ /gnyis pa rjes thob tu ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ thun 'jog khar bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la brten nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rang grol du gyur nas/ mthar thug phyag rgya chen po mngon du byed par gyur cig ces mnyam bzhag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngos te/ de kho na nyid ma rtogs pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba la snying rje chen po mngon du byas nas mnyam bzhag gi nyams dang ma bral bzhin du/ rang lus yi dam lha dang / spyi bor bla ma bsgoms te/ gang la yang zhen pa med par sems kyi 'og nas ston par 'gyur ba'i chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bya ste/ rang gi sems ngal gso ba las/ /snying rje chen po mdun bzhag ste/ /de nyid ma g.yengs rtag blta zhing / /lha dang bla ma'i sbyor ba yis/ /sgrub pa po ni ngal gso bya/ /zhes par ltar ro/ /gnyis pa de nyams su blangs pas thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin ngo sprad pa la bzhi ste/ ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i rgyu/ ji ltar skye ba'i tshul/ ting nge 'dzin rang gi ngo bo/ nyams su myong ba ngo sprad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgo gsum dben par gnas nas bya byed dang rnam par rtog pas dben pa nyid lam phyag rgya chen po rnam par mi rtog pa skye ba'i rgyu yin te/ gsang ba grub pa las/ las kyi phyag rgya 'phro rgyun can/ /ye shes phyag rgya'ang de bzhin te/ /rnam rtog mang po spangs byas la/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas las/ las kyi phyag rgya nyid dang ni/ /btags pa'i ye shes phyag rgya yang / /mchog tu mi 'gyur sbyor ba yis/ /phyag rgya chen mo bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / rdo rje snying po las/ lus ngag sems ni dben byas nas/ /rtog med ting 'dzin skye bar nges/

/rtog med ting 'dzin skyes gyur na/ /mi rtog ye shes skye bar nges/ /zhes so/ /der ma zad sngar bstan pa'i rkyen gsum dang ldan pa'i brda thabs kyi khrid/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi zung du 'brel ba 'di nyid kyang rgyu yin te/ dus 'khor 'grel chen las/ sngags kyi theg pa 'dir yid ches pa'i rkyen rnam gsum bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ re shig dang por yid ches pa rgyud kyi rkyen dang / de nas yid ches pa bla ma'i rkyen dang / de nas yid ches pa rang gi rkyen te/ yid ches pa'i rkyen gsum gyis yongs su dag pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lam yin no/ /zhes so/ /de la rgyud kyi rkyen ni/ rtsod pa med cing tshang la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs la/ lam cha tshang du ston pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa dang / bshad rgyud kyis gsal bar byas pa ste/ bsdus rgyud du/ de'i phyir 'jig rten pa'i rgyud kyi bla ma ma lus ma tshang ba med pa 'jig rten las 'das pa/ dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud du/ rgyal ba mchog gi bdag po mngon par rjod byed zla bzang kye/ zhes dang / mtshan brjod du/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la/ /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /yang dang yang du gsungs pa gang / /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i rgyud kyi nang na don tshang bar bzhugs pa'o/ /bla ma'i rkyen ni/ rab mngon shes lnga ldan gyi gdul bya'i khams dbang po bag la nyal shes pa/ 'bring rgyud 'grel bshad rgyud dang bcas pa shes shing / mnyam rjes gnyis kyi dam tshig la gnas pa rang gi rtogs shing nyams su myong ba de ma sbas shing gsal bar ston pa gcig dgos te/ mchog mi 'gyur du/ de bzhin du yang 'khor bar ltung ba rnams la lam ston pa med par ni lam mthong ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /gang gi tshe lam ston pa po dang lhan cig 'grogs nas ma brtan yang de'i tshe lam med do/

/gal te lam ston pa po dang po rnam par dag pa'i lam nas ma 'ongs na yang de ltar na yang lam med do/ /zhes dang / bsdus rgyud du/ des na sangs rgyas zhal ni gang gi thugs dang zhal gnas pa de dpal ldan bla ma'o/ /zhes so/ /rang gi rkyen ni/ dbang thob cing dam tshig lam gnas pa bla ma las man ngag thob par 'khor 'das kyi skyon dang / yon tan shes pas 'jig rten pa'i bde ba spangs te mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i don du lus srog la yang mi ltos par lam la brtson pa ste/ dus zhabs pas/ mngon par dbang ni thob ma thag /'jig rten bya ba dor nas ni/ /gnyis med ye shes bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa lhas/ sgrub pos 'khor ba thog med pa can gyis sdug bsngal dran par byas la/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba 'dod pas 'du 'dzi spang bar bya'o/ /tha na rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la yang sdug bsngal gyi 'du shes bsgom par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ til 'bru tsam la yang dngos por 'dzin pa'i blo spang bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ don dam pa'i bden pa la mngon par dad pas lus dang srog la yang ltos pa med par bya'o/ /de bzhin du 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub phra mo dang / grub pa chen po brgyad la yang don du gnyer bar mi bya ste/ g.yeng bar 'gyur ba dang / bzlog par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro zhes so/ /gnyis pa ji ltar skye ba'i tshul ni/ bla ma'i man ngag las/ g.yo thob goms brtan mthar phyin lnga/ /bsam gtan lam gyi skye tshul yin/ /ri gzar chu dang tsi ti dang / /rgan po sbubs kyi chu dang ni/ /ri bo lta bu'i dpe lnga bstan/ /zhes pa ltar/ dang po g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ bsgoms pas blo ye mi gnas par gcig rting la gcig 'phro bas rtog pa mang du song ba snyam byed pa 'byung ste/ dper na ri gzar gyi chu bzhin no/ /de ni bsgom skye snying 'dod pas rtog pa ngos zin pa yin no/ /de nas thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/

bar bar du cung zad rtog med du gnas pa ste/ dper na bya tsi ti mo bzhin no/ /de nas goms pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ rtog pa cung zad 'phro yang phal cher rtog med du gnas te/ dper na rgan po'am 'khar gzhong gi rus sbal bzhin no/ /gsum pa goms pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ de'i dus su rkyen gyis bsgom la gnod do/ /de nas brtan pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ rtog med rgya 'byam pa ste/ dper na sbubs kyi chu bzhin no/ /de'i dus su rkyen gyis gnod do/ /mthar phyin pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ bsgoms pa las gang gis kyang mi gnod cing / slar rkyen gyis bogs 'byin pa/ dper na ri bo lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ting nge 'dzin ngo sprad pa la gnyis/ mdo bstan bcos kyi dang / rgyud man ngag gi ting nge 'dzin ngo sprad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis kyi mdo'i ting nge 'dzin ngo sprad pa ni/ ma bcos pa gsum la brten nas skye tshul lnga rim bzhin du skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin de nyid la rgyu'i sgo nas/ ye shes phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin las/ dge slong yon tan 'tshol bar 'dod pa dag /ting nge 'dzin la rab tu sbyar ba yi/ /ma bsdams rnams dang dri ma med byas te/ /bse ru lta bur dgon par gnas par bya/ /zhes so/ /rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i le'u las/ srid gsum thams cad sems las grub par 'gyur/ /sems de nyid kyang rtag tu bstan du med/ /gzugs med lung du ma bstan sgyu ma 'dra/ /mkhas pas de ni sems kyi chos nyid 'tshol/ /de ni sems kyi chos nyid tshol ba na/ /sems dang sems kyi chos nyid mthong ba med/ /sems de sems gang gis ni 'tshol byed pa/ /sems de yang ni rang bzhin mthong ba med/ /ces dang / dgongs 'grel las/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' ji tsam gyis na bsgom pa lags/ bka' bstsal pa/ gang gi tshe rgyun chags su yid la byed pa sems kyi mtshan nyid yid la byed pa'o/

/ji tsam gyis na gcig tu zhi gnas bsgom pa lags/ bka' bstsal pa/ gang gi tshe rgyun chags su yid la byed pas bar chad med pa'i sems yid la byed pa'o/ /ji tsam gyis na zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gnyis 'dres par gyur te mnyam par 'jug pa lags/ bka' bstsal pa/ gang gi tshe sems rtse gcig pa nyid yid la byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /dpe'i sgo nas kyang brgyad stong pa las/ byang sems yum la spyod pa'i tshe/ rgya mtsho mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod de/ ting nge 'dzin des rnam par spyod pa'i byang chen myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas so/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du nam mkha' mu med pa dang / ri bo lta bu zhes sogs gsungs so/ /lta stangs kyi sgo nas/ gtsug tor rnam par blta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod de/ zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ /snang tshul gyi sgo nas rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod de/ zhes dang / de bzhin du nor bu sgron ma/ zla ba sgron ma/ nyi ma snang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod de/ ting nge 'dzin des rnam par spyod pa'i zhes sogs gsungs shing / blo gros rgya mtshos zhus par/ sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed gang gis sman du mi mthong ba'i gzugs su snang ba de gang yang med do/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpas kyang byang chub tu mi mthong ba'i chos su snang ba de gang yang med do/ /zhes so/ /byed las kyi sgo nas/ go cha'i bgod pa bstan pa'i mdo las/ gang gis rnam par rtog pa'i g.yo ba thams cad spangs pa gang yin pa de ni 'phags pa'i lam la gnas pa dang / 'jigs pa med pa'i lam la gnas pa dang / rab tu zhi ba'i lam la gnas pa dang / rab tu bde ba'i lam la gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /lam 'di ni rga ba dang /

na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / sdug bsngal med pa'i gnas su phyin par byed do/ /zhes so/ /'bras bu'i sgo nas/ sdud par/ rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin 'di rig sngags che/ /sems can khams mang mya ngan sdug bsngal chos zhi byed/ /gang dag 'das dang gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mgon/ /rig sngags 'di bslabs sman pa'i rgyal po bla med 'gyur/ /gang dag phan dang snying brtser bcas pa spyad spyod pa/ /rig sngags 'di la bslabs nas mkhas pa byang chub reg /'dus byas bde dang 'dus ma byas de gang yin pa/ /bde ba de kun 'di las byung bar rig par bya/ /zhes so/ /bstan bcos kyi ting nge 'dzin ngo sprad pa ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis byang chub sems 'grel las/ dmigs pa dang ni bral ba'i sems/ /nam mkha'i mtshan nyid la gnas te/ /nam mkha' sgom par byed pa 'di/ /stong pa nyid ni sgom par bzhed/ /ces gsungs shing / mgon po byams pas kyang / 'di la gsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong nas rnam par grol/ /zhes dang / slob dpon rta dbyangs kyi don dam pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i rim pa las/ mtshon yang mtshon bya ma yin te/ /'di la gsal bya ci yang med/ /stong pa nyid kyang stong pa ste/ /'di la sangs rgyas sems can med/ /bdag gzhan snang zhing srid pa'i chos/ /rnam grol rnam par bcings pa yang / /ming tsam ming yang yod ma yin/ /thams cad nam mkha' dang 'dra ste/ /de ltar chos rnams mthong med na/ /mi mngon mi snang 'jam dpal mthong / /zhes dang / mkhan po zhi ba lhas/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa/ /de tshe rnam pa gzhan med pas/ /dmigs pa med pa rab tu zhi/ /zhes dang / dpyad bya rnam par dpyad byas na/ /rnam dpyod la ni rten yod min/ /rten med phyir na mi skye ste/ /de yang mya ngan 'das par brjod/ /ces dang /

thams cad nam mkha' 'dra bar ni/ /bdag 'dras yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ /zhes dang / jo bos kyang / zab zhing spros bral de bzhin nyid/ /'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa gang / /ma skyes ma 'gags gzod nas dag /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /chos dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa/ /blo mig zhib mo rtog bral ba/ /bying rgod rab rib med pas lta/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa rgyud dang man ngag gi ting nge 'dzin ngo sprad pa la/ rgyud kyi ting nge 'dzin ngo sprad pa ni/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud du/ sems ni dri ma dang bcas las kyi phyag rgya dag dang btags pa'i ye shes phyag rgya yang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyu ru mchog gi rgyal ba skyed mdzad phyag rgya bzang mo bsgom/ /gos med mi 'gyur mun pa kun 'joms mkhas mnyam khyab mdzad rnal 'byor gyis ni bgrod/ /lus la gnas pa'i ye shes gzi brjid srid pa'i sdig 'phrog dus kyi 'khor lor rig /ces dang / gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dam pa'i don du dngos po rnams/ /srid gsum dngos po med par bsgom/ /dngos po med pa bsgom pa'i dngos/ /bsgom par bya ba sgom pa min/ /de bas dngos po dngos med pa/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /zhes dang / phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid dang / /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes dang / dgyes pa'i rdo rjer/ gang phyir yid kyis mi sgom par/ /'gro ba thams cad bsgom par bya/ /thams cad chos ni yongs shes na/ /sgom pa nyid ni bsgoms pa min/ /zhes dang / rang gi rig pa'i ye shes 'di/ /ngag gi lam 'das spyod yul te/ /'di ni byin rlabs rim pa'i phyir/ /kun mkhyen ye shes de lta bu/ /zhes dang / dpal sdom pa las/ sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur tam/ /ma byon na yang rnam kun tu/ /rgyun chad med pa'i chos nyid ni/ /'phel 'grib spangs te gnas pa yin/ /zhes gsungs shing /

mtshan brjod du/ rnam par mi rtog lhun gyis grub/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas las byed pa/ /zhes dang / nam mkha'i lam la rab gnas pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu chen po 'chang / /zhes dang / phyag rgya chen po thig le la/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /rnam pa thams cad dang bral ba/ /mchog gi rnam pa skye med dag /rang dgar nyams su myong ba dngos/ /de ni rang bzhin zhes su myong bshad/ /ces dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud nas/ dag byed sdig pa 'jig byed pa/ /sangs rgyas de nyid bsgrub pa ni/ /sngags bzlas pa dang bsam gtan dang / /bde bas kyang ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sam ṭar/ chos dang chos min rnam par spangs/ /de phyir rtog pa'i dra ba ni/ /spangs na zab mo'i chos ni 'phel/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i lam/ /lam rig rnam par rtog mi bya/ /rnam rtog gti mug chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /man ngag gi ting nge 'dzin ngo sprad pa ni/ sa ra has/ der ni thog ma dbus mtha' med/ /srid min mya ngan 'das pa yin/ /bde ba chen po mchog 'di la/ /bdag dang gzhan du yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / kye ho rmongs pas sems kyis sems rtogs na/ /lta ba ngan pa thams cad rang grol te/ /mchog tu bde chen de tsam zhig tu bas/ /de yi dbang gis dngos grub dam pa'o/ /grogs dag zab mo dang ni rgya che ba/ /gzhan gyis bdag nyid rtogs pa ma yin te/ /lhan cig skyes pa zhi ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /gnyug ma nyams su myong bas rab tu shes/ /zhes rgya cher gsungs shing / dpal gsang ba grub pa las kyang / dpe las 'das shing brjod du med/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /mtshan ma med pa'i rdul dang bral/ /mya ngan 'das shes de la bshad/ /gang la mchog ces brjod byas te/ /phyag rgya chen por mngon par gnas/ /lha rdzas longs spyod grol ster ba/
