/mya ngan 'das pa'i go 'phang mchog /ces dang / slob dpon chen po dā ri ka pas kyang / /gnyis ka'i rang bzhin dbyer med pa/ /sems kyi rang bzhin shes nas ni/ /sems kyi rgyu ba kun spangs te/ /mnyam pa'i ro la gnas par bya/ /zhes so/ /slob dpon chen po ke ra li pas kyang / /rgyu la 'bras bu la yang rgyus rgyas gdab/ /rgyu 'bras gcig tu rgyas btab la/ /phyag rgya chen po skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / slob dpon tog tse bas/ gnyis med don ni dam pa lags/ /ma skyes pa dang mi 'jig pa/ /mi 'gyur ba dang mi gnas pa/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /ces dang / lu hi pas/ khyi rgod mi srun sna la sbrang rtsi bskus pas phyogs rnams kun tu za bar byed/ de bzhin blo dman skal min rnams la bla ma'i man ngag byin pas rang rgyud sreg /skal ldan skye med rtogs pa rnams ni snang ba thug phrad tsam gyis rnam rtog 'joms/ /dper na glang chen rab brtan myos pa'i sna la ral gri btags pas dgra dpung 'joms/ /zhes dang / bir+wa pas/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas lhan cig skyes pa de/ /mi bsam mi rig bdag med ngang la bzhag /chad par mi 'gyur nyams su myong bas ngang gis rig /rtag par mi 'gyur mngon zhen med pas zung du 'jug /ces dang / ku ru kar+ṇa ri pa'i zhal nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad ngo bo gcig /de ni rtogs na rang bzhin rang gi sems/ /rtogs par 'dod na ma bcos ji bzhin zhog /goms par byas na rnal 'byor mngon du 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa nyams su myong ba'i ting nge 'dzin ngo sprad pa la/ ngo sprod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / ji ltar ngo sprad pa'i tshul gnyis kyi dang po la gsum las/ ngo sprad pa'i yon tan ni/ rnal 'byor pa rang gis bsgoms pa'i nyams myong de/ bla mas legs par ngo 'phrod na sangs rgyas rang la rnyed pa dbul pos khyim du gter rnyed pa lta bu dang / sdug bsngal bde bar 'gyur ba gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lcags gser du bsgyur ba lta bu dang /

nyon mongs pa grogs su 'char ba dug la sngags btab pa lta bu'i yon tan yod do/ /gnyis pa ngo ma sprad pa'i nyes pa ni/ ngo ma 'phrod par rang ngo rang gis ma shes pa gdon gyis brlams pa'i smyon pa lta bu dang / ci byas sdug bsngal du 'gyur ba dug can gyi zas zos pa lta bu dang / nyon mongs pa spang gis ma spongs pa nags la me mched pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa sprad na 'phrod pa'i dpe ni/ ngo sprad pas snang ba'i sgo nas rang snang stong par shes pa chab rom chur shes pa lta bu/ stong pa'i sgo nas stong nyid snang bar shar ba chu nang gi zla ba lta bu gnyis ka'i sgo nas snang stong dbyer med du rtogs pa nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ji ltar ngo sprad pa'i tshul la gsum ste/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i phyag rgya chen po ngo sprad pa dang / de gsum mtshon byed kyi dpe sna tshogs phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprad pa dang / de thams cad zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes su ngo sprad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ gzhi dang / lam dang / 'bras bu'i phyag rgya chen po ngo sprad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhi sems nyid phyogs ris su ma chad pa 'khor 'das gnyis kyi gzhir gyur pa ngo bo rang bzhin gyis stong pa 'di nyid rgyu'i lhan cig skyes pa zhes bya ste/ dgyes pa'i rdo rjer/ 'di nyid ye shes chen po nyid/ /thams cad lus la rnam par gnas/ /dngos po dngos med bdag nyid mchog /thabs dang shes rab shin du 'dres/ /chags dang chags bral rnam par 'dres/ /'di nyid srog chags rnams kyi srog /de nyid yi ge dam pa nyid/ /'di ni 'gro ba'i bdag nyid de/ /'di ni thams cad khyab pa po/ /thams cad lus la rnam par gnas/ /zhes dang / rang gi ngo bo la ltos nas de nyid du/ rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa po/ /lus gnas lus las ma skyes pa'o/ /zhes dang / dgongs pa bla na med pa las/ /chos rnams thams cad dngos med phyir/

/chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam spangs pa/ /bdag med chos la yang dag byung / /byang chub tshul nyid bstan pa'o/ /'gro ba med cing 'ong ba med/ /'gag med rab tu zhi ba med/ /rtag dang chad pa rnam par spangs/ /dus gsum mkhyen pas ma byas pa/ /rtog pa nam mkha' dbyer med mtshan/ /de kho na nyid don dam ste/ /so so rang rig mtshan nyid do/ /zhes so/ /in+d+ra bhū tis kyang / 'gro kun lhan cig skyes zhi ba/ /rtag tu 'byung zhing rang la gnas/ /dus kun tu ni mi zad pa/ /rtog pas btags pa spangs pa nyid/ /rang dang phyi rol rang gnas pa/ /phyi dang nang las ma skyes pa/ /zhes so/ /rtogs tshul gyi sgo nas dgyes pa'i rdo rjer/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste/ /'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtogs mi 'gyur/ /'khor ba gzugs dang sgra la sogs/ /'khor ba tshor ba la sogs pa/ /'khor ba dbang po rnams nyid de/ /'khor ba zhe sdang la sogs pa/ /'di rnams chos ni mya ngan 'das/ /rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can nyid/ /rmongs med 'khor ba dag pas ni/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de la chos sku dang rdo rje 'chang gi dbugs dbyung / /stong nyid/ myang 'das/ ye shes sku/ yi ge haṃ zhes kyang gsungs te/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ haṃ ni dngos po dang bral bas/ /lus la gnas kyang lus skyes min/ /dbang po las 'das mi gsal ba/ /rnam pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /dngos dang dngos med las grol zhing / /gang du lhag par mi gnas pa/ /dngos po thams cad nub pa dang / /chos kyi sku yi rang ngo bo/ /sems ni rdo rje 'chang dbugs dbyung / /don kun byed pa dang bral ba/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin mya ngan 'das/ /ye shes sku yi rang bzhin nyid/ /brjod dang brjod bya rnam par grol/ /de yang yi ge haṃ du drag /ces so/ /'di nyid gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pas bslad pas phyin ci log sna tshogs su 'gyur te/

bsdus rgyud du/ sa gzhi gang zhig la gnas dpag bsam shing dang bcud dang mchog gi bcud dang rdul phran las byung ba'i/ sman dang gzhan yang bcud kyi dbang po mtha' dag nad rnams sems can rnams kyi mi mthong bar/ gang zhig tha mal pa yi+i rtswa dang shing dang chu dang rngul dang rdo dang lcags su mthong bar 'gyur/ /yi dwags rnams kyis chu la me dang dmyal bar gnas pa'i mi yis kun nas gcod dang dbugs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar snang yang bden par grub pa med do/ /bden na rigs gcig tu mthong dgos pa la tha dad du mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /theg bsdus 'grel par/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /lha rnams ji ltar rigs rigs su/ /dngos gcig yid ni tha dad phyir/ /don ma grub par 'dod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu rig pa dang yul sna tshogs su snang ba'i ngo bo ni phyag rgya chen po ste/ chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba sangs rgyas thams cad skyed par byed pa yin pas so/ /de'ang ye shes le'u'i 'grel par/ /phyag rgya chen po ni chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i mtshan nyid dang / rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed par mdzad ma ste/ chos 'byung gi sgra yis de la brjod do/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa lam phyag rgya chen po ngo sprad pa la bzhi las/ dang po snang stong phyag rgya chen po ngo sprad pa ni/ gzhi'i phyag rgya chen po'am lhan cig skyes pa de nyid lam 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'bras bu ye shes kyi sku can gyis phyag rgya chen po bsgrub par bzhed pa'i rnal 'byor pa la 'og nas 'char par 'gyur ba ltar/ du ba nas sna tshogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i bar du gsal la ma 'gags par snang ba'i stong pa'i gzugs brnyan sna tshogs pa ni snang stong phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ste/ dus 'khor zhabs kyis/

bla na med pa'i byang chub la rgyas btab par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ phyag rgya ni yod pa dang med pa las 'das par gyur pa'i phyir sgyu ma dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /dper na me long gi gzugs gcig po ni me long gi nang du mthong ba dang / sngon gyi las la ma ltos par gnang ba'o/ /phyi rol gyi dngos po de nyid me long la snang ba yang ma yin te/ rang la gnas par gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /de las ma gtogs pa yang ma yin te/ de bzhin du rnal 'byor pa sbyor ba yan lag drug rtag tu bsgoms pa'i dbang gis rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid kyi gzugs brnyan ni nam mkha' la mthong zhing nang yid kyi dbang pos kyang de bzhin du mthong ngo / /zhes dang / bsdus rgyud du/ phyag rgya <!TCC Tibetan character 4,99 undefined in unicode!>bsdus rgyud nas 'chos sgyu ma'i rjes mthun nam mkha' yid kyi me long nang gi gzugs 'dra bar/ 'jig rten gsum ston byed cing dri med glog 'dra 'od zer du ma 'phro bar byed/ phyi dang lus la dbyer med lus dang bral te mkha' la gnas shing snang ba tsam sems dang sems byung rang bzhin 'gro ba du ma la 'khyud gcig pa yin te du ma'i tshul zhes dang / dus 'khor rtsa rgyud du/ mig gnyis ma phye ma btsums pas/ /gang zhig stong par ma btags par/ /rmi lam bzhin du gzugs mthong 'gyur/ /gzugs de rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / gzhon nu ma yi pra las ni/ /ma mthong ba yi rkun mo mthong / /nyi tshe ba yi mig gnyis kyis/ /bskyod de sgrub pa po yis mthong / /gal te yod pa'i gzugs mthong na/ /bdag gi gdong pa cis mi mthong / /'on te med pa'i gzugs mthong na/ /ri bong rwa ni ji ltar min/ /mig gzhan gyis ni mi mthong zhing / /bdag gis mig gis kyang mi mthong / /ma skyes pa nyid mthong ba yin/ /gzhon nu ma yi bu bzhin no/ /zhes dang / gzugs dang gzugs min rnam par grol/

/me long la ni pra phab bzhin/ /zhes so/ /de la bsdus rgyud kyi lung gis cung zad bkrol na/ sna tshogs stong gzugs mig shes la snang ba de dag ni/ dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i stong pa nyid ces bya ste/ pañtsikā pad+ma can las/ rgyal ba zhes bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'o/ /de rnams kyi bdag po ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' yin la mchog ces bya'o/ /de'i phyag rgya ni dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du gyur ba'i phyag rgya chen po ste/ las kyi phyag rgya la sogs pa las khyad par du gyur pa dang / bla na med pa'i byang chub ster bar mdzad pas na phyag rgya bzang mo zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /'di nyid ni sgyu ma ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa ste/ phyag na rdo rjes/ de ltar phyag rgya chen po sgom pa ni/ pra phab pa dang / sgyu ma dang mtshungs pa dang / sprin med pa'i nam mkha' ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan no/ /zhes so/ /de phyi rol gyi don ma yin nam zhe na min te/ ye shes le'ur/ sa yi rnam par sra ba min zhing khu ba chu lus khu ba ma yin te gsher ba nyid min pa'i phyir/ me yi rnam pa me min g.yo ba rlung gi lus ni gang zhig g.yo ba yin pas rlung ma yin/ stong pa'i rnam pa yin yang blta bya dkar dang ljang dang kha dog sna tshogs chen po kha dog min/ rnam pa thams cad pa yang blta bya min te rang snying dri ma nyon mongs bdud kyi mthu las so/ /zhes so/ /ci yin na sems yin te/ de nyid las/ de la kun mkhyen gzugs ni chu la nyi ma lta bur gos pa med pa kha dog sna tshogs te/ /rnam pa kun ldan rang sems yul dang rnam par bral ba dag go sems ni gzhan pa min pa nyid/ /ces dang / mtshan brjod las/ gzugs med gzugs bzang dam pa nyid/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid las skyes/ /zhes so/ /gang du mthong na mdun gyi nam mkha' la'o/ /gang gis na rang bzhin sems kyis so/

/dpe ni me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar sems stong pa nyid du shar ba yin gyi/ rdul phra rab las grub pa ni ma yin te/ pañtsi kā pad ma can las/ gzhan yang me long la sogs pa'i nang du gzhon nu mas yul las ma gtogs pa'i sngar mthong ba ji lta ba bzhin du/ lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba'i rten du gyur ba'i sna tshogs gzugs ni rnal 'byor pas ma brtags kyang mthong bar gyur pa'o/ /zhes so/ de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas na khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad smra ba dang mtshungs par mthong ste/ pad+ma can las/ nam mkhar khams gsum po sna tshogs pa'i gzugs kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa gang gis mthong ba de dag gis byin gyis rlob pa ste/ rang gi khams gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i rang bzhin mthong ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ /zhes so/ /de ni dri ma med pa'i glog dang 'dra bar 'od zer du ma 'phro bar byed pa can te/ phyag na rdo rjes/ sgrib pa thams cad dang bral ba pra ti se na lta bu'i phyag rgya chen po 'bar zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa'i 'od zer gyi sprin 'phro ba'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par mdzes pa can/ zhes so/ /de nyid phyi rol dang / nam mkha' dang / nang gi rang gi lus la mthong ste/ pad+ma can las/ rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid kyi gzugs ni nam mkha' la mthong zhing / nang du yid kyi dbang pos kyang de bzhin du mthong ngo / /zhes so/ /nang du yid kyi dbang pos de ni dang por nam mkha' la mthong ste/ ye shes thig le las/ mchog gi nam mkha'i gnas na bzhugs/ /zhes so/ /de'ang rang gi nyams su myong bar gyur pa'i bdag nyid lam yin gyi lkog tu gyur pa blo'i yul las 'das pa lam ma yin te/ yes ler/ sems la snang ba tsam ste rang gi yid las skyes shing me long gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams dang ni sangs rgyas kyi rten rnal 'byor dbang pos brten par bya/

/ye shes snang ba rgyas pas bdud dpung g.yul bcas ma lus sreg par byed/ /'dod chags sogs pa nyams pa'i bde ba rnal 'byor pa yi lus la ster te rnal 'byor las/ /zhes so/ /sems dang sems byung rang bzhin zhes pa sems gcig nyid stong gzugs dang / yul can de 'dzin pa'i shes pa gnyis kar 'gyur bas/ dri med 'od du/ stong pa nyid gyi gzugs la bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i sems te gzung bya'i sems kyi snang ba dang 'dres pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de ni 'gro ba du ma la gdod ma nas 'khyud cing gnas pa yin te/ phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ nam mkha' chos kyi dbyings yin te/ dbyings ni son zhes su dran/ chos rnams kun gyi nang na yod/ /rgyu dang mchog gi gnas yin no/ /zhes so/ /de nyid ni rang gcig yin yang du mar snang ste/ phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ sna tshogs du ma la sogs dbye/ /rang bzhin gcig la rtag tu shar/ /du mar smra ba cis ni bcing / /rang bzhin bdag nyid 'di thams cad/ /kun rdzob rnam pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /chu yi zla ba bzhin du mthong / /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa 'od gsal phyag rgya chen por ngo sprad pa ni/ nang du sems la sems kyis bltas pas gsal zhing rig pa sna tshogs su 'char yang / brtags na skye 'gag gnas dang bral ba rnam par mi rtog pa ste/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud du/ sems can sems nyid 'od gsal zhing / /'dod nas skye 'gag gnas bral te/ /thog ma med pa'i sngon rol nas/ /dang po mchog gi sangs rgyas te/ /rgyu med rkyen gyis ma bslad pa/ /zhes so/ /de nyid la dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje zhes bya ste/ dri med 'od las/ 'dir gang gis snying rje dmigs pa med pa rnam par rtog pa dang bral ba/ stong pa nyid rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa dus gsum gsum 'jug pa yongs su shes pa dang ldan pa gang yin de ni sangs rgyas pa'i grub pa'i mtha'i nges pa'o/

/zhes so/ /de nyid ni rgyu'i lhan cig skyes pa dang 'dra bar lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang lhan cig skyes pas na/ lhan cig skyes pa zhes bya ste/ nam mkha' che rgyud kyi snying po las/ gang dang mtshungs par skyes pas na/ /des na lhan cig skyes par brjod/ /ces dang / rtog dang bral zhing mngon sum pa/ /rgyal ba'i yid kyi mtshan du gsungs/ /rtag dang chad dang bral ba nyid/ /mtshan dang mtshan gzhi spangs pa ste/ /gzhan yang snying rje mngon brjod pa'i/ /lhan cig skyes par ngas brjod bya/ /zhes so/ /de nyid ni du ba la sogs pa'i rtags yul du byed pas yul yul can gyi spros par mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ mi 'gyur te/ nam mkha' che rgyud snying po las/ /mig sgyu la sogs rtags lnga ni/ /gal te rang bzhin gyis grub na/ /nam mkha' che las tha mi dad/ /rtags dang rtags can de rtogs pas/ /gsum po de rnams tha mi dad/ /'od gsal ba las khyab pa'i phyir/ /de yang nam mkha' chen po yin/ /zhes so/ /'di nyid med par dngos grub thob par mi 'gyur la/ rtogs pa tsam gyis dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur te/ rgyud de nyid las/ 'od gsal nam mkha' chen po ni/ /nam mkha' dang mtshungs dri med yin/ /blang bya min la dor bya min/ /'di ni dam tshig chen po ste/ /'od gsal nam mkha' ma gtogs pa/ /rnam pa gzhan gyis rnyed mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de nyid kyang stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin las mi 'da' bas phyag rgya/ 'khor ba'i bag chags dang bral bar gyur pas chen po zhes so/ /gsum pa bde stong phyag rgya chen po ngo sprad pa ni/ snang stong dang 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i lam de nyid yang dang yang du goms pas/ rtsa chad 'thud/ rtsa mdud bral te/ 'khor lo drug gi thig ler/ srog brtan zhing rlung 'pho med/ khams 'dzag med du gyur nas sems kyi snang ba ste skye 'jig med pa'i stong pa dang / sems so sor snang ba'i ye shes rnam par 'dres te ro gcig par gyur pa ni bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes zhes bya ste/

bsdus rgyud du/ lus 'di nyid la ro drug ma lus zos shing 'thungs pa las ni khams kyi tshogs su 'gyur ba'o/ /'byung ba rnams las ro drug nges par gsal te 'byung ba'i tshogs rnams nam mkha'i khams las byung / /stong pa dang ni ye shes rnam par 'dres par gyur pas ro mnyam pa las 'gyur med rtag pa'o/ /de ltar 'byung ba las gnas zhi ba srid gsum la gnas gyur pa rang gi lus la rig par bya/ /zhes dang / ye shes le'u'i 'grel par/ de ltar sems ni rnam pa bzhi rnams srid pa gsum du gyur pa'i srog chags rnams kyi thig le'i dbus/ /khyab byed bde mnyam 'bras ster thar pa'i rgyu ru rnal 'byor dbang po rnams kyis bsrung bar bya ba ni/ /rnal 'byor rnams la mchog gi bde ba skyed byed thig le btang na thar ba gang la 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / grel pa las/ kun tu bzang po mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba chen po nam mkha'i khams kyi mthar thug pa kun tu gsal bar byed pa rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs bsdus pa zab cing rgya che ba rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba thog ma med pa bdag dang bdag gi ba'i gzung ba dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa spangs pa dus thams cad du nyon mongs pa med pa'i chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin shes pa/ 'khor ba'i bag chags las grol ba/ 'gro ba ma 'ongs pa rnam par spangs pa/ spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin la rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi gzugs rnams la gnas pa/ bum pa bzang po dang / dpag bsam gyi shing dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu bzhin sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa rdzogs par byed pa/ thub pa chen po'i spyod yul dang bral ba/ sems can gyi phung po chen po mchog tu zhi bar byed pa/ sgyu ma lta bu dang / rmi lam lta bu dang / gzugs brnyan lta bu/ sgra brnyan lta bu ste/ de ltar srid pa gsum gyi mchod gnas rnal 'byor gyi ye shes rang rig pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba rnal 'byor pas spang bar mi bya zhes de bzhin gshegs pa'i nges pa'i zhes so/

/bzhi pa de dag la gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad tshang bar ngo sprad pa ni/ sngon 'gro bzhi dang / rten bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / ma bcos pa gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas mnyam par bzhag pa las rnal 'byor pa rang gis nyams su myong ba'i snang stong gsal stong bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin de nyid las gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad tshang ste/ gzhi sems can gyi skabs kyi snod bcud kyi chos rnams kyang tshang bar/ kye rdo rjer/ 'di nyid 'gro ba'i bdag nyid do/ /'di nyid thams cad khyab pa po/ /thams cad lus la rnam par gnas/ /dngos dang dngos med de las byung / gzhan rnams gang rnams de rnams dang / /rnam par shes pa kun gyi tshul/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du des rnam rtog las yid skyobs pas sngags dang / dmigs med snying rje'i sbyor bas kha na ma tho ba spong bas dkar thub dang / mtshan rtog gi dri ma sel bas khrus dang / nyan thos pa'i rnam rtog sreg pas sbyin sreg dang / bde bar 'gro bas lha dang / de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gnas pa'i rgyu yin pas dkyil 'khor nyid de/ kye rdo rjer/ de ni sngags bzlas de ni dka' thub de sbyin sreg /de ni dkyil 'khor can dang de ni dkyil 'khor nyid/ /ces so/ /bden pa gnyis kyang tshang ste/ sna tshogs stong gzugs dang sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba kun rdzob kyi bden pa brtags na sems kyi rang bzhin las gzhan du ma grub pa don dam pa'i bden pa ste/ 'phags pa lhas/ bden par na sems nyid dbyibs dang kha dog dang bral bar snang ba tsam nam mkha' mnyam pa'i ngo bo nyid dam pa'i bden pa dang 'dra bar rig par dka'o/ /de lta mod kyis snang ba tsam gyis snang ba gsum po rlung la brten te gyur pa dang / thun mong du gyur pa yang de/ des na rlung gi rnam par shes pa bcings pa ma yin no/ /des na thabs dang shes rab kyi snang ba gnyis po 'od zer lnga dang bcas shing /

sna tshogs pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /stong gzugs du ma dang rnam rtog sna tshogs bden par med bzhin du snang ba kun btags dang / yon tan ma lus skye ba gzhan dbang dang / chos can rnam rtog tsam de'i steng du bdag gnyis kyis stong pa yongs grub bo/ /de bzhin du ye shes kyi tshogs 'phel bas tshogs lam des gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa che rags thams cad spong bas sbyor lam/ des rlung sems dbu mar tshud de sngar ma mthong ba'i chos nyid mngon sum mthong bas mthong lam/ des spang bya thams cad spong thob bya thams cad thob par byed pas sgom lam/ rlung sems kyi 'jug pa thams cad de bzhin nyid kyi ngang du thim pas mthar phyin pa'i lam mo/ /rang gi sems la ye shes chen po rang bzhin gyis gnas pas rgyu rgyud/ mtshan bcas mtshan med la sogs pa'i ye shes mngon sum du rtogs par byed pas thabs rgyud/ bde chen ye shes de nyid mngon sum du gyur pas 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /lam des theg pa dang thabs dman pa thams cad las skyob pas skyabs 'gro/ rang sems sangs rgyas kyi rnam par dag pas sangs rgyas rjes dran/ mnyam rjes la brten nas chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin rgyud la goms par byed pas chos rjes dran/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi ltung ba thams cad dang bral bas dge 'dun rjes dran no/ /de nyid la rnam thar sgo gsum yang tshang ste/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis nyon/ /stong nyid ye shes mtshan nyid ni/ /lus la gnas pa de nyid mchog /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /chos rnams thams cad snang ba med/ /mtshan nyid stong pa nyid du 'dod/ /de la ye shes bde ba che/ /'od gsal ba ni rnam dag pa/ /gang phyir a ba dhū tīr zhugs/ /yang dag stong pa nyid du 'dod/ /ces so/ /de la 'bras bu'i chos thams cad kyang tshang ste/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi rim lnga las/

sgyu mar bstan pa'i mtshan nyid kyis/ /de nyid nges par mtshon pa ste/ /kun rdzob bden pa sgyu ma nyid/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yang de/ /de ni dri za'i sems can 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i sku yang de nyid yin/ /zhes so/ /de nyid la sku gsum yang tshang ste/ sems nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba chos sku/ bde ba chen po longs sku/ sems kyi 'gro 'ong sna tshogs sprul sku ste/ snying po'i 'grel pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad par/ sems nyid ma bcos chos kyi sku/ /snang ba bde chen longs spyod rdzogs/ /'gro 'ong sems can sprul pa'i bdag /dam pa dag las rtogs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /ye shes lnga tshang ste/ sna tshogs stong gzugs gsal ba me long lta bu/ gzung 'dzin ro mnyam pa mnyam nyid ye shes/ stong gzugs dang rang gi sems la so sor rtog pas sor rtog ye shes/ de nyid kyis 'bras bu'i yon tan byed pas bya grub ye shes/ shin tu rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid yin pas chos dbyings ye shes te/ kye rdo rjer/ de nyid me long ye shes gzugs/ /mnyam nyid ye shes dngos po can/ /yang dag gyur pa so sor rtog /de nyid bya ba nan tan nyid/ /chos kyi dbyings ni rnam dag ma/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor bdag po'i bdag /de nyid bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin can/ /zhes so/ /rigs lnga yang tshang ste/ me long dag gi gzugs brnyan ltar/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi gzugs brnyan du gsal bar snang bas rnam par snang mdzad/ rtog pas mi sgul bas mi bskyod pa/ de la brten nas mngon shes rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa thob ste sems can gyi don mdzad pa 'byung bas don yod/ rgyal ba'i yon tan gyi gter yin pas na rin 'byung / mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin yin zhing chos rnams kyi bdag nyid yongs su spyod pas 'od dpag med/

rtog pas mi phyed cing dus gsum du mnyam par rtogs pas rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ kye rdo rjer/ rnam snang mi bskyod don yod dang / /rin chen dpag med sems dpa'o/ /zhes so/ /de nyid ni dmigs med snying rje dang shes rab zung du chud pas kye rdo rje yin te/ brtag pa gnyis par/ he ni snying rje chen po nyid/ /badz+ra'ang shes rab brjod par bya/ /zhes so/ /de nyid dus kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ste/ 'grel chen du/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i sku/ /dus ni kun rdzob gzugs ldan pa/ /stong pa 'khor lo zhes su brjod/ /dus 'khor gnyis su med par 'dod/ /ces so/ /de nyid ni bde ba dang stong pa dbyer mi phyed pas bde mchog ces kyang bya ste/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ saṃ zhes bya ba bde bar bshad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bde ba'i mchog /sgyu ma thams cad mnyam sbyor bas/ /mchog tu bde ba bde ba'i mchog /ces so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum dbyer mi phyed par 'dus pa'i rang bzhin yin pas gsang ba 'dus pa yin te/ 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ sku gsung thugs ni rnam pa gsum/ /gsang ba zhes ni sangs rgyas yin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad ces bya ba/ /tshogs pa 'dus pa yin par brjod/ /ces so/ /de dag tu ma zad/ de nyid la ming sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas bstan te/ dus 'khor 'grel par/ dper na bud med dang na chung ma la sogs pa las bud med kyi ming gcig pu gtso bo ma yin te/ thams cad kyi nu ma dang skrar ldan pa'i dngos po ston par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du yi ge e dang / gsang chen dang / pad ma dang / chos 'byung dang / nam mkha'i khams dang / bde ba chen po'i gnas dang / seng ge'i khri dang / bha ga dang / gsang ba'i ming gi nang nas/ yi ge e'i ming gtso bo ma yin te/ ming thams cad kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i stong pa nyid brjod par byed pa'i phyir ro/

/zhes so/ /de thams cad kyang stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin las mi 'da' bas phyag rgya/ yon tan gyis che bas na chen po'o/ /gsum pa 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po ngo sprad pa ni/ de lta bu'i lam phyag rgya chen po bsgoms pas rnal 'byor pa'i srog stong pa nyid kyi sku la zhugs te/ sems rtog med/ rlung 'pho med/ khams 'dzag med kyi ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin pa'i tshe sku nyi tshe ba ma yin te/ sku sna tshogs pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i sku rdo rje dang / gsung nyi tshe ba ma yin par gsung sna tshogs pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa gsung rdo rje dang / thugs nyi tshe ba ma yin pas mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pas dus kun tu 'khyud cing sems can gyi bsam pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i thugs rdo rje ste/ de lta bu'i sku gsung thugs dang ldan pas gzhan don du lhun grub tu 'byung ste/ ye shes kyi le'ur/ sku ni rdul phra rab tu zhig pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i mtshan la sogs pa rdzogs par 'gyur/ 'jig rten gsum la sgrib pa rnam par bral ba rmi lam lta bur dang por sna tshogs mthong ba'o/ /gsung ni rgyun mi 'chad par skad gzhan du ma rnams kyis gzhan gyi snying la 'jug par 'gyur ba'o/ /thugs ni bde ba dam pas gang ste 'gyur ba med pa lhan cig skyes pas dus kun 'khyud pa'o/ /zhes so/ /phyag rgya sogs sngar dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa de mtshon byed kyi dpe sna tshogs phyag rgya chen por ngo sprad pa ni/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i phyag rgya chen po de dag zung 'jug tu mtshon par byed pa'i dpe sgyu ma smig rgyu rmi lam sgra brnyan chu zla mig yor dri za'i grong khyer la sogs pa sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis po thams cad snang ba'i dus na phyi rol gyi dngos po sna tshogs pa'i ngo bor bden pa ltar snang yang / snang ba'i dus nyid na stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa phyag rgya chen po ste/

phyag rgya chen po thig ler/ chos dbyings bha ga zhes byar bstan/ /dbyings ni sems su shes par bya/ /sems can khams ni mtha' yas la/ /sems ni de yi rgyu yin no/ /kun rdzob rnam pa'i gzugs su ni/ /chu zla lta bur mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa las/ des na de bzhin gshegs pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams sgyu ma lta bu dang / chu zla dang / mig yor dang / smig rgyu dang / rmi lam dang / sgra brnyan dang / dri za'i grong khyer dang / mig 'phrul dang / dbang po'i gzhu dang / glog dang / chu bur dang / me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin nye bar 'dzin pa'i tshul lo/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa de thams cad zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes su ngo sprad pa ni/ de lta bu'i sbyang gzhi phyag rgya chen po la'ang / rig pa sna tshogs snying rje/ brtags na de'i rang bzhin stong pa shes rab ste/ rig tsam nyid na stong pas thabs shes dbyer med dam zung du 'jug pa zhes bya'o/ /brgyad stong pa las/ sems ni sems ma mchis te sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes so/ /de sbyong byed kyi lam la'ang goms pas phyi'i yul snang ci rigs pa 'gags nas stong gzugs sna tshogs snang ba ni shes rab/ nang dran rig gi 'gyur ba dag pa'i 'od gsal mi rtog pa dang / bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes ni snying rje ste/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa zhes bya ste/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud du/ stong pa las byung gzugs ni rgyu/ /'bras bu mi 'gyur las skyes bde/ /'bras bus rgyu la rgyas gdab cing / /rgyu yis 'bras bu rgyas gdab bo/ /stong nyid gzung 'dzin rgyu yin te/ /'bras bu snying rje mi 'gyur 'dzin/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems su de brjod do/ /zhes so/

/lam 'di mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu la'ang / gzugs sku gnyis snying rje/ chos sku shes rab/ de dag thams cad dbyer med pa ni zung 'jug ces bya'o/ /phyag rgya zhes pa de thams cad gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu'i bye brag gis phye bas mthar thug de bzhin nyid kyi ngang du ro mnyam pa ste/ sa ra has/ 'khor ba de nyid mya ngan 'das par nges/ /zhes dang / kye rdo rjer/ nga las 'gro ba thams cad byung / /nga las gnas gsum po yang 'byung / /nga yis 'di kun khyab pa ste/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin gzhan ma mthong / /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de nyid las lhag pa'i chos gzhan med pa'am/ 'khor ba'i bag chags dang bral bas chen po zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa bsgoms pas 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i tshul ni/ gang zag rab kyis 'di lta bu lam la brten nas tshe gcig gi 'bras bu mngon du byed de/ nyi zla bsgrub pa las/ rnal 'byor dbang rab rnams kyis ni/ /don dam phyag rgya che brten nas/ /mi g.yo bsam gtan sbyor ba yis/ /rgyu mthun bde stong ting 'dzin bsgom/ /lo gsum zla phyed gsum gyis ni/ /mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par gsungs/ /zhes so/ /'bring gi rab kyis lus spangs ma thag bar dor 'grub par byed de/ ye shes thig le las/ yang na lus ni spangs ma thag /brtson pa mi ldan pas kyang 'grub/ /ces so/ /'bring gi tha mas skye ba gnyis na 'thob ste/ rnal 'byor dbang po rab tu g.yo ba'i yid ldan gal te rnal 'byor ma 'thob 'chi bar gyur pa na/ /dpal ldan mi yi 'jig rten du ni rab mchog thub pa'i rigs su rnal 'byor ldan pa skye bar 'gyur/ /de yis sngon du goms pas slar yang ye shes rnal 'byor mchog tu rgya chen nyams su len par 'gyur/ /ye shes thob par gyur na mi zad mchog gi gnas te slar yang gang yang skye ba ma yin pa/ /zhes so/ /tha mas mi'i skye ba bdun na 'thob ste/ gal te lam du zhugs pa/ 'chi bar gyur pa de tshe zhes pa de yin skye ba gzhan la'o/

/zhes pa'i 'grel par/ skye ba bdun gyi mthar thug pas brtson 'grus dang ldan pa ma yin pa dang / yang dag pa'i ye shes ma bsgoms kyang nges pa'o zhes so/ /de dag lam la zhugs nas mi dge ba la mi 'jug cing lam bsgom pa'i dbang du byas kyis/ mi dge ba la zhugs na re shig dmyal bar 'gro zhing / ma bsgoms na ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan gang yang mi 'byung ste/ bsdus rgyud du/ rnal 'byor pa rnams 'khu bar byed na ngu 'bod la sogs dmyal ba chen po rnams kyi mthar 'gro 'gyur/ zhes dang / 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa las/ yang dag sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di/ /thos pa tsam gyis mi 'grub bo/ /dper na la la chu klung gis/ /stobs med nan gyis khyer ba bdag /skoms nas shi bar gyur pa bzhin/ /ma bsgoms chos kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / dper na mtsho chen gnyan pa zhig /skye bo thams cad sgrol byed kyang / /bdag nyid de na 'chi 'gyur ba/ /ma bsgoms chos kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /des na sngar bstan pa'i ting nge 'dzin de'ang / ma yis bu skyong ba bzhin bsam gtan gyi ma mas byang chub ma thob par du bskyangs shing / mchod pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i mchod pa phul bas 'khor ba rgyun gcod par byed de/ ye shes le'ur/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas yin te chen po'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'di na yod pa min/ /de rnams rnam par mi rtog pa yis mnyes par byas par dpag tu med pa'i srid pa gcod par byed/ /ces so/ /brgyad pa drod rtags bstan pa la gnyis kyi/ dang po sems gnas pa'i rtags la/ mthong rtags/ lus nyams/ rmi nyams/ sems nyams dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ lta stangs kyi lam nas mun nag gi nam mkha' sems sang nge gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas g.yas kyi rlung lnga rim gyis dbu mar tshud pa'i rtags/ dang po du ba lta bu kha dog ser po'am sa tshub lta bu kham long long ba dang /

de nas smig rgyu lta bu kha dog sngo ba'am/ skya ba g.yo ba dang / de nas srin bu me khyer bar snang du dmar rtseg pa'am/ skya tseg tseg pa 'od 'phro ba dang / de nas mar me lta bu 'od 'bar ba mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon sogs su 'byung ba dang / de nas sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu sngo la dwangs pa nam mkha' thams cad khengs pa mthong bar 'gyur la/ de brtan nas sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la nyin mo'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas/ g.yon gyi rlung lnga rim gyis dbu mar tshud pa las nyin mo'i rtags rnams 'byung ste/ dang po 'bar ba zhes pa nam mkha' me 'bar ba lta bu'i rnam pa dang / zla ba dang nyi ma'i rnam pa dang / sgra gcan rin po che nag po'i rlung nga'i rgyab lta bu dang / mchog gi cha bar snang gi glog lta bu'i rnam par mthong bar 'gyur la/ de nas rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong gzugs thig le dang bum pa dang / ras yug la sogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gzugs mthong bar 'gyur zhing / thig le yang kha dog ser po/ dkar po/ dmar po/ nag po/ sngon po/ ljang gu sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa can 'byung ste/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ye shes sna tshogs thig le zhes tha snyad mdzad do/ /de nas thig le'i nang du longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / sprul pa'i sku sna tshogs pa mthong ba ni rnam pa mchog ldan gyi sku zhes bya la/ de'i tshe rnam par gzhom du med pa'i sgra thos pa 'byung ngo / /de nas bsgom pa bstan pa ni thig le kha dog ci rigs pa'i dbus su/ ri mo nag po sbom phra skra'i tshad tsam la ring thung ci rigs pa'i nang du rgyal ba'i sku dang rigs drug gi gzugs sna tshogs mthong ba 'byung ba ni/ nges pa'i sku'am brtan pa'i sku zhes bya ste rtags kyi mthar thug pa yin no/ /de dag kyang ye shes le'ur/ nam mkhar kun nas zhen pa'i sems dang mig ni mi 'dzum rdo rje'i lam du rab tu zhugs pa yis/ /stong pa la ni du ba smig rgyu rab gsal dri ma med pa'i mkha' snang nyid dang mar me dang /

/'bar ba dang ni zla ba nyi ma rdo rje rnams dang mchog gi cha dang thig le mthong bar 'gyur/ /de yi dbus dang sangs rgyas gzugs ni yul dang rnam par bral ba du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /nam mkha' chu 'dzin bral ba dag ni rnal 'byor pa yis bgrad pa'i mig gis blta bar bya ba ste/ /re khā nag po dri med 'od zer 'phro ba dus kyi rtsa la mthong bar 'gyur gyi bar du'o/ /de la kun mkhyen gzugs ni chu la nyi ma lta bu gos pa med pa kha dog sna tshogs te/ /rnam pa kun ldan rang sems yul dang rnam par bral ba dag go sems ni gzhan ma yin pa nyid/ /ces so/ /'on te phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la 'di lta bu'i rtags snang 'chad pa mi rigs so/ /snyam na ma yin te/ du ba la sogs pa'i lam nyid phyag rgya chen po yin par rgyud 'grel las kyang gsungs shing / nag po pas mdzad pa'i do ha la sogs pa phyag rgya chen po ston pa'i man ngag du ma nas gsungs pa'i phyir dang / lam rnal ma sgom pa'i gang zag la rtags snang 'di rnams nges par 'byung la/ de ngo ma shes na bar chad du bzung nas lam sgrub pa'i gegs su 'gro ba srid pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ lam bsgoms pas rlung lnga zin pas lus la nyams lnga 'byung ste/ sa rlung zin pas lus lci la sdod tshugs pa dang / chu rlung zin pas lus grang la 'jam pa dang / me rlung zin pas lus drod che rngul mang / rlung gi rlung zin pas lus bde zhing 'dug mi tshugs/ nam mkha'i rlung zin pas lus yang zhing med pa snyam byed pa 'byung ngo / /gsum pa ni/ sa rlung zin pas rmi lam du du ba'am sa 'tshub pa'am khur gyis mnan pa dang / ri rdo khang pa chen po mthong bar rmi chu rlung zin pas grur zhugs pa dang / chu la rkyal ba dang / chu chen po rmi/ me rlung zin pas me 'bar ba dang mar me du ma rmi/ rlung gi rlung zin pas rta rgyug pa dang / bya'i khyu nam mkha' la 'phur ba rmi/

nam mkha'i rlung zin pas thang chen po dang / ri'i rtse mo nas nam mkha' dang sa gzhi yangs po mthong ba rmi ba 'byung ngo / /bzhi pa/ sa rlung zin na sems bying ba'am sa gting du song ba snyam byed pa 'byung / gti mug shas che/ chu rlung zin pas sems gsal dwangs dang / nga rgyal shas che/ ri'i me rlung zin pas cung zad 'phro zhing 'tshig pa za/ 'dod chags shas che/ de dus su ngal gso la bsgom mo/ /rlung gi rlung zin pas sems spros kyang mi 'phro bar gnas/ phrag dog shas che/ nam mkha'i rlung zin pas mi rtog pa la gnas shing stong shas che/ ser sna shas che ba 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa yon tan 'phel ba'i rtags ni/ lus sems la dga' bdes rgyun mi 'chad par gang zhing / dang por snang ba slob dpon du shar nas gang snang ba'i dus su chos nyid rang bzhin du lhag gis rtogs pa 'byung ste/ kyu ru ra rlon pa mthong nas de'i ro shes pa bzhin no/ /de nas snang stong gnyis slob dpon du shar nas ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis rlung sems nang du 'dus te/ chos thams cad bden pa'i snying po med pa snang stong dbyer med du lhag gis 'char ba nyi ma shar bas mun pa spangs pa lta bu 'byung ngo / /de nas bde ba chen po sngon la shar te rnam rtog thams cad sems la thim nas sems dran rig ci byung ba thams cad bde stong dbyer med du myong ba lan tshwa chu la thim pas chu la lan tshwa'i ro bro ba lta bu 'byung ngo / /dgu pa bogs dbyung ba ni/ sgrim glod gnyis res 'jog dbri bskyed gnyis res 'jog ste bzhi/ kha zas res 'jog spyod lam bag yangs/ sems kyi gnad sna tshogs su 'pho ba yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pa ste bogs dbyung ngo / /dang po ni lus sems gnyis ka sgrim pa dang thun dbri ba dus gcig gnyis ka khong glod pa dang thun bskyed pa dus gcig tu byas la/ de gnyis nyi ma dang po la thun res 'jog

de nas nyi ma res 'jog tu bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ kha zas bsil drod dang che chung dang por thun dang / de nas nyi ma res 'jog tu byed pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ spyod lam dal ba dang / sgom pa po rang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin bag yangs su bsten pa'o/ /bdun pa ni/ mdo dang rgyud du ma nas 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs pa sna tshogs la yid gtad de/ gcig la dmigs pa brtan pa dang / gzhan rnams la'ang dmigs pa spos te bsgom pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ mig gis gzugs sna tshogs lta ba nas/ lus kyi reg bya sna tshogs reg pa'i bar du bsten par shes pa yul gyis tshim nas yul de nyid kyi steng du mi g.yo bar rtse gcig tu gnas pa 'byung ngo / /de la yang dang yang du goms par byas pas blo gnas pa la sogs ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ni bsam mi khyab nas 'byung yang phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'i man ngag du 'dra ba'i phyir 'di bris so/ /bcu pa phan yon ni/ gnas skabs su lus shing bal gyi 'dab ma ltar yang ba dang sems la snang dmigs kyi dngos po thams cad bde bar 'char te/ sdug bsngal gyi rkyen gyis kyang bde ba skye bar 'gyur te/ brtag gnyis su/ bde ba gnag cing bde ba ser/ /bde ba dmar po bde ba dkar/ /bde ba ljang gu bde ba sngo/ /bde ba rgyu dang mi rgyu kun/ /bde ba shes rab bde ba thabs/ /de bzhin kun tu ru skyes bde/ /bde ba dngos dang dngos med bde/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde bar brjod/ /ces so/ /de la brten nas rtsa'i mdud pa rigs pa dral te rlung sems dbu mar rim gyis chud pa las/ nang ltar du byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun bgrod nas/ sa bcu gnyis sam bcu gsum mngon du byed par 'gyur te/ mngon brjod bla ma las/ rab tu dga' dang dri ma med/ /'od byed pa dang 'od 'phro ba/ /sbyang dka' ba dang mngon du gyur/ /ring du song dang mi g.yo ba/

/legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin/ /dpe med pa dang ye shes ldan/ /rdo rje'i sa ni bcu gsum pa/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa rjes bsngo ba dang smon lam zung 'brel du bsgom pa ni/ sngon 'gro bzhi dang / dngos gzhi bskyed rdzogs dang / 'og nas 'chad pa'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor drug la sogs pa nyams len gang dang gang gi rjes su 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su bsngo ba dang / gnas skabs kyi smon lam gyis zin par bya ste/ de las mnyam bzhag rjes thob kyi dge ba rnams mi zad cing 'phel bar 'gyur te/ mdo las/ ji ltar chu thigs rgya mtsho che nang lhung / /rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi zad/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / /byang chub ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa de las gzhan pa'i man ngag nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ bla ma gnyan gyi zhal nas/ mnyam bzhag de las langs phan chad sgom med du byed dam snyam na/ de lta ma yin te/ chu bo dang 'dra bar bar ma chud du nyams su len te/ de'ang gang gā la sogs pa'i chu bo rnams nyin mtshan rgyun ma chad par phyin pas/ phyin du ma tshor bar rgya mtshor sleb pa bzhin du rnal 'byor drug rgyun ma chad par nyams su blangs pas sangs rgyas bsgrubs su ma tshor bar 'grub pa yin gsung / 'di nyams su len pa la rnal 'byor drug ste/ bza' ba zas/ bgo ba gos stan gyis/ nyal ba gnas khang gi/ gnyid 'od gsal/ 'chi khar 'tshang rgya ba 'pho ba'i/ bar dor 'tshang rgya ba 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la gsum las/ mgron bskyed pa ni sngar gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor gsal na des chog mi gsal ba'am gzhan du'ang / bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pas spyi bo'i bla ma/ bla ma kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid dang / yi dam la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pas rang yi dam kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid thugs rje chen po dang / tha na nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can lus kyi srin bu yan chad yi dam gyi lhar bsgom mo/

/de nas ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang la ma yengs par ting nge 'dzin pa'i rdzogs rim nyams su blang ngo / /gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bza' btung ci yod mdun du bzhag nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod de/ yid kyis yig 'bru gsum 'od du zhu ba las dngos po dman pa sbyangs nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi ro nus pa dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur par bsam mo/ /gsum pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bla ma la mchod par 'bul lo/ /zhes spyi bo'i bla ma kun 'dus dang / yi dam la mchod pa 'bul lo zhes pas rang lus yi dam kun 'dus dang / sems can lhar gyur pa thams cad la zhal zas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa gya nom pa phul pas mnyes par bsams la rang nyid tshim par longs spyad do/ /de la bla ma gnyan gyi zhal nas/ 'di lta bu'i bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis ma zin pa'i gong phan chad mi phal gcig dud 'gro dang khyad mi 'dug ste/ ltogs na za/ skoms na 'thung ba tsam dud 'gro la'ang yod gsung / 'di lta bu'i gdams ngag gis zin tshun chad zas ci tsam zos shing 'thung ba tsam gyis tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa yin te/ de'ang thabs bskyed pa'i rim ngang nas zos pa dang 'thungs pa thams cad bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'gyur zhing / shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ngang nas zos pa dang 'thungs pa thams cad ye shes kyi tshogs su 'gyur ba yin gsung ngo / /gnyis pa la gsum las/ mgron bskyed pa sngar dang 'dra la/ gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gos stan bzang ngan gang yod oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas lha'i na bza' phun sum tshogs pa dang / stan yang zhi khro dang mthun pa'i rin po che'i khri dang / pad+ma dang nyi zla la sogs par bsam mo/ /de'ang gos stan gsar pa rang gis bsgrubs pa'am/ gzhan gyis phul ba'am/ g.yar ba lta bu la dang por byin rlabs cis kyang byed dgos la/ sngar byin gyis brlabs zin yin na bskyar la mi dgos gsungs so/

/gsum pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ dbul ba'i tshul/ gong dang 'dra la/ gdul bya'i dngos po/ lha zhi ba la dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i gdan/ khro bo la stag gi spags pa glang chen gyi ko rlon nyi ma'i gdan la sogs pa rang rang la mthun par phul bar bsams la longs spyad do/ /de la bla ma gnyan gyi zhal nas/ 'di lta bu'i gdams ngag gis ma zin pa'i gong phan chad mi phal gcig gos stan bzang po sna tshogs gcig bsgrubs nas/ legs su re'am grang gis dogs nas gyon zhing 'dings ba tsam las med pa la/ 'di lta bu'i gdams ngag gis zin tshun chad gos gyon zhing stan bting ste/ longs spyad pa tsam gyis tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa yin gsung / de'ang thabs la sogs pa 'gre'o/ /bla ma gnyan rang la na bza' bem po 'char pas yag pa gcig las med skad do/ /gsum pa la'ang gsum las/ mgron bskyed pa sngar dang 'dra/ gnyis pa ni byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gnas gang du sdod kyang yig 'bru gsum brjod pas/ rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru gzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa phyi gsal nang gsal gcig tu bsgom pa ste/ kun spangs chos rje'i zhal nas/ 'di ltar bsgom pa 'di mkhar lan byed na sa chog gi mchog kyang yin gsung ngo / /gsum pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ 'bul ba'i tshul gong dang 'dra la/ dbul bya'i dngos po rgyal po la sogs pa'i gzhal yas khang dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa rkyang pa dang brtsegs pa dpag tu med pa phul bar bsams te longs spyad do/ /de la bla ma gnyan gyi zhal nas/ 'di lta bu'i bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis ma zin pa'i gong phan chad/ mi phal gcig khang pa la gad dar sna tshogs gcig byas nas btsan du re'am/ grang gi dogs sam/ 'jab bde ru re'i byed pa las med pa/ 'di lta bu'i gdams ngag gis zin tshun chad/ gnas gang du 'dug kyang tshogs gnyis kyi rgyu 'ba' zhig tu 'gro gsung / de'ang thabs sogs 'gre'o/ /khong rang la'ang gnas khang bdag tu bzung ba gcig kyang med skad do/

/bzhi pa la gsum gyi/ sbyor ba'i chos ni skyabs 'gro sngon 'gro ltar byas la/ sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gis mkha' mnyam sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du gnyid 'od gsal bzung snyam du yid kyis dran par bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ni/ bskyed rim gsal btab nas rang gi spyi gtsug nas lte 'og sor bzhi'i bar du/ rtsa dbu ma sbom phra sba lcag tsam gyi nang gi snying kha'i thad tsam du yi dam mthe'u chung tsam rang dang 'dra ba gcig bsgom/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros spyi bo'i bla ma la phog dbu ma'i nang na mar byon nang gi yi dam gyi gtsug tor du ye re bzhugs pa la sems ma g.yengs par byas la/ glo g.yas pa 'og tu phab/ sngas mtho ba la mgo bzhag ste ma ṇi bgrang gnyid du 'gro khar ci yang mi sems par lus sems khong glod nas ma g.yengs par gnyid log go /gsum pa 'od gsal zin pa'i rtags ni/ snga ma ltar nyams su blangs pas gnyid srab na snga mo'i 'od gsal zin pa'i rtags rmi lam gsal po dang bcas pa'i gnyid kyi ngang du rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes pa dang / rmi lam gyi snang ba thams cad phyag rgya chen por ngo shes pa 'byung ngo / /gnyid mthug na mthug po'i 'od gsal zin pa'i rtags sems gsal la rtog pa med par gnas pa dang / gnyid sad ma thag mdun gyi bar snang la rtags snang dang bcas shing nyin mo khams bde la sbyor bzang ba la sogs pa 'byung ngo / /de la bla ma gnyan gyi zhal nas/ 'di lta bu'i bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis ma zin pa'i gong phan chad mi phal gcig nyin mo 'du 'dzi la sogs pas g.yengs te/ mtshan mo gti mug gis mnan nas khres stabs su gnyid du 'gro ba las med pa la/ 'di lta bu'i gdams ngag gis zin tshun chad/ gnyid thun che na sgom thun che gnyid thun chung na sgom thun chung bar 'gyur ba yin/ nam zla rgya byed dge ba'i sbyor du 'gro ba'i gnad yin gsung ste/

de'ang kye rdo rje las/ gnyid ni spang bar mi bya ste/ /dbang po'i rnams ni mi dgag go /zhes dang / gnyid log sad pa mi phyed pa/ /rtag tu rmi lam 'dra bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgya gar tu/ bla ma la ba pas kyang / lo bcu gnyis mnal log nas 'od gsal bsgoms pas/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i grub pa brnyes par gda' gsung nga ོ/ /lnga pa la gsum las/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sngar dang 'dra/ sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gis mkha' mnyam sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang snyam du yid kyis dran par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ 'chi ba rim gyis pa la rim gyis nyams su blang ba'i tshul dang / 'chi ba cig car ba la btsan thabs su 'pho ba dang / skyon yon gnyis kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la sbyang ba dang / las la sbyar ba gnyis kyi dang po la bzhi las/ ji ltar sbyang ba ni/ rang lus yi dam gyi sku khru ma bus pa lta bu khong pa stong sang nge bar bsams pa'i spyi bor bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo'i bzhugs stangs ltar 'dug pa'i zhabs gnyis tshangs bug gi g.yas g.yon du gzhag par bsam/ rang gi lus kyi dbus na rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba spyi gtsug nas lte 'og sor bzhi'i bar du sleb pa sbom phra sba lcag 'bring po tsam bsams pa'i yas sna tshangs pa'i bu ga hāṃ sngo skya mgo thur bstan gyis bkag pa'i mjug ma dang bla ma'i thugs rje gnyis lcags kyu bzhin du 'brel bar bsam/ de nas dbu ma'i nang gi snying ka'i thad kar yi dam mthe'u chung tsam gsal la rdzogs pa dang / mar sna gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag gi steng du sems kyi rten thig le dkar dmar sngo ba'i mdangs can 'od zer lnga 'phro ba gcig bsams te/ 'og rlung 'then pas rlung gi stobs kyis thig le de shig gis song ste/

de las thig le sngo skya dung g.yu'i mdog lta bu sran ma tsam gcig chad/ dbu ma nas song nas snying kha'i yi dam la skor ba gcig byas/ spyi bo'i haṃ la sor rdo rgyab pa bzhin phog pa dang / spyi bo'i bla ma'i thugs rje'i lcags kyus tshangs bug gi haṃ thon nas/ spyi gtsug rgya skar phye ba bzhin skya thal byung bar bsam/ yang 'og sgo cung zad glod pas thig le de yas mar sngo hril li li byung / thugs ka'i yi dam la skor ba byas/ gsang gnas kyi gzhi'i thig le la thim pas kha dog sna tshogs su gyur/ yang 'og rlung 'then pas sngar bzhin thig le yar byung / yi dam la skor ba byas tshangs bug nas thon bla ma'i thugs kar reg tsam byas/ myur byung yi dam la skor ba byas/ gzhi'i theg le la thim par bsam/ de lta bu gcig nas nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar kha yar gyi bar du 'byongs rtags ma byung gi bar du nyams su blang ngo / /'di la sdig po che gseb lam nas/ btsan thabs su sangs rgya ba'i man ngag gam/ ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'pho ba'i gdams ngag zer ro/ /de la bla ma gnyan gyi zhal nas/ ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'pho ba zer yang bsgom dgos te/ da lta shes pa gsal dus su ma bsgoms na ngar chen ngar chung thug pa'i dus su 'pho mi nus te/ lkugs kha'i brda tshon dka' gsung / da lta mi phal gcig tshe phyi ma pas zla ba phyi ma ngos snga snyam ste/ tshe phyi ma ngos snga ba srid cing / yong ngos shes pa 'chi ba yin pas 'chi kha'i man ngag 'di lta bu bar ma chad par sbyang zhing tshigs su chud dgos pa yin no gsung ngo / /gnyis pa 'byongs ba'i rtags ni/ spyi gtsug za ba dang / 'phrig pa dang / 'bur ba dang / spyi gtsug tu rlung gzer dang / shes pa 'phro rgod sna tshogs 'byung ngo / /de'i tshe 'pho nus pa yin zhing / spyi gtsug 'bur na mi rdol bar bzhag gsungs so/ /gsum pa spogs pa'i cho ga ni/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las yi dam gyi dbu'i gtsug tor lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa gcig tu bsam/

'og rlung hig ces pa'i ngag gis 'dren pas yar 'then pa dang / gzhi'i thig le thams cad mar byung yi dam la skor byas thugs kar thim/ yi dam yar byung tshangs bug nas sku phyed yan chad steng du thol byung / gtsug tor gyi rdo rje'i rwa nas bla ma'i thugs rdo rje'i lcags kyus drag tu 'then par bsam/ de nas ka zhes pa'i ngag gi 'gyur bas 'og rlung glod pa dang yi dam mar byon nas thugs kar bzhugs/ thig le thugs ka nas thon mar byung / chos 'byung gi thig le la thim par bsgom/ de mang nyung nyams la dri/ thun 'jog tsa na yi dam gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros spyi gtsug gi bla ma la phog pas/ dbu ma na yar byon tshangs bug haṃ gis bkag bla ma yi dam gyi gtsug tor du bzhugs par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa gegs bsal ba ni/ bsgom drags na spyi gtsug skrangs/ ro stod na/ sems 'phro rgod dus su ma chod na/ lus stong ra khrol tshags/ shes pa thur du gtad la/ rlung smad du 'bebs pa'i 'khrul 'khor ha dang dbyug pa la sogs pa'i gdams ngag dang / kha zas dang spyod lam la sogs pa pha rol po'i khams dang sbyar zhing gsal bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis kyi las sbyor dngos ni/ dang po rang la bdog pa'i dngos po rnams lhag ma med par dge phyogs su btang / bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba'i nyes pa thams cad bshags bsdam bya/ bya ma'i yi dam las rang gis dbang blangs te dam tshig dang sdom pa nyams pa thams cad gsor gzhug dge ba byas pa rnams gsal btab nas da gdod 'pho ba bya ste/ de'ang lus 'di chags kyang 'byung ba lnga la chags/ gnas kyang 'byung ba lnga la brten te gnas/ mthar 'chi ba na yang 'byung ba lnga bsdus pa la brten nas 'chi bar 'gyur la/ sdud tshul yang mdzod du/ me yis bdun ni chu yis gcig /de ltar chu bdun thal nas ni/ /me yis bdun no de nas kyang / /mjug tu rlung gis 'jig par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis phyi snod kyi 'jig pa'i rnam gzhag bstan pa dang tshul mtshungs te/

dang por sa chu la thim pas lus kyi stobs 'chor/ chu me la thim pas chu gsum mi thub/ nang gi gsher ba'i dngos po rnams bskam/ me rlung la thim pas lus kyi drod mtha' nas sdud/ kha sna mig gsum bskam/ rlung rnam shes la thim pas nang dbugs thung / phyi'i dbugs ring / g.yal ba dang ig bu la sogs 'byung / rnam shes 'od gsal la thim pa'i dus su phyi'i dbugs 'chad cing snying kha yan chad du drod cung zad tsam yod pa dang lus kyi mdangs gsal zhing snum pa/ lus la lag pas reg na cung zad 'jam pa snyam byed pa 'byung / de tsa na 'pho ba'i dus yin pas/ de dus 'pho ba'i dran sor dang po 'byung ba sdud pa'i mgo tshugs tsam nas bla ma'am mched grogs kyis sngar nyams myong gang la brtan pa dang / bla ma gang mos la skya bskyon nas gsal 'debs bya zhing 'pho ba gdab pa ni/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis dran yul du slongs tsam gsal gdab/ 'og rlung 'then nus na 'then du bcug la dmigs pa gsal gdab/ 'then mi nus na yang 'di ltar gsal gdab ste/ sngar sbyangs pa lan gsum byas pa'i phyi ma la thig le sngo skya de mar byung / mar sleb tsam na khab len gyi rdos khab blangs pa bzhin du rlung sems dbyer med pa gzhi'i thig le sngo dmar de lhag ma med par yar hril byung nas gcig tu 'dril te/ skar mda' lam du zhugs pa bzhin du dbu ma na yar hril byung thugs ka'i yi dam la thim/ yi dam yang yar byon tshangs bug nas rgyangs 'thon nas bla ma'i thugs kar thim/ bla ma yang skar mda' bzhin song nas rdo rje 'chang gi thugs kar thim par bsams pa'i ngang la sems ma bcos spros bral gnyug ma'i ngang du lhod glod nas ma g.yengs par gnas pa'i rdzogs rim gyi ngang la bzhag go /gdams ngag 'di nyams su len pa'ang med du mi rung ba'i gnad rnam pa gsum ste/ tshe 'di la ma chags pa dang / gang 'pho bar 'dod pa'i gnas su 'dun pa drag po dang / gdams ngag la yid ches po'o/

/de la bla ma gnyan gyi zhal nas/ 'di la 'pho ba rgya skar ma zhes kyang zer/ ye shes skar mda'i 'pho ba zhes kyang zer/ 'pho ba gzha' tshon ma zhes kyang zer/ 'od kyi gong bu'i 'pho ba zhes kyang zer/ sku gsum gyi 'pho ba zhes kyang zer/ 'og min gsum gyi 'pho ba zhes kyang zer/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i 'pho ba zhes kyang zer te/ 'pho ba thams cad 'di la 'dus pa yin gsung ngo / /kun spangs chos rje'i zhal nas kyang / 'pho ba thob pa la glod pa shin tu gal che ste/ skyas chen po 'degs pa la 'jigs skrag 'ong srid pas ci nus su glod pas thebs pa yin gsung ngo / /de ni tshangs bug sangs rgyas pa thob ces pa'i don yin no/ /gnyis pa tha ma lus bcos te 'pho ba ni 'chi ltas shar zhing / ngag gi smra brjod spong zhing sems gsal ba'i dus su nad g.yog grogs mched la sogs pa tsa na yod pa'i mi la kha ta byas la/ nga 'chi khar lus gnad skyil krung ngam/ gzhogs g.yas pa 'og tu bcug pa'am/ tha ma'ang sgal tshigs drang po tsam cig gis/ sna bug g.yas pa nga rang gi srin lag g.yas pas sam/ srin bal la sogs pas khog la rlung rgyu ru ma gzhag smad kyi cha la rnam pa thams cad du ma reg mya ngan dang chags sdang gi gtam ma gtong / chos kyi gleng mo dang bla ma yi dam dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa dang skyabs 'gro gyis/ nga la yang de ltar gyis shig gis dran bskul/ dbugs 'gro khar spyi gtsug gi skra dal bus yang yang 'then cig byas la/ 'chi ba'i dus su sngar gyi dmigs pa'i steng nas 'pho bar bya'o/ /de yang 'chi ltas ma tshang na 'pho ba'i dus la ma bab pa yin pas 'phos na nyes pa can du 'gyur te/ gdan bzhi las/ dus la bab na 'pho zhes bya/ /dus min lha ni gsod par byed/ /lha ni bsad par gyur pa na/ /mi ni nges par dmyal bar 'tshed/ /ces so/ /bla ma gnyan khong rang sku 'da' kar/ spyi bor zan 'bru tshos pa tsam gyi drod byung ba yin skad do/

/gnyis pa 'chi ba cig car ba la btsan thabs su 'pho ba ni/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi bskyed rim dang / spyi bo'i bla ma dang / snying kha'i yi dam rtsa dbu ma gsang gnas kyi chos 'byung gi steng gzhi'i thig le rnams skad cig dran rdzogs su gsal gdab ste/ sbyong ba'i dmigs pa rnams bzhag ste/ las sbyor gyi mtha' thig le lhag ma med pa'i dmigs pa'i steng nas 'pho'o/ /gsum pa skyon yon gnyis kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni/ 'chi ltas kyi gtugs bzhin du 'di lta bu'i rnal 'byor gyi steng nas tshangs bug nas mi 'pho bar 'og gi lam nas 'pho na ngan song du skye bar 'gyur te/ mkha' 'gro ma kun tu rtog pa'i rgyud las/ rnam shes rlung la bzhon nas ni/ /'og gi lam nas 'phos gyur na/ /chos la goms pa'i gang zag kyang / /ngan song dag tu skye bar 'gyur/ /mgron po lam du zhugs pa'i mi/ /grogs kyis bsgyur ba ji bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /dus su 'pho ba'i yon tan gyi rgyud de nyid las/ rnam shes rlung la bzhon nas ni/ /steng gi lam nas 'phos gyur na/ /sdig la goms pa'i gang zag kyang / /mtho ris dag tu skyes bar 'gyur/ /mgron po lam du zhugs pa'i mi/ /grogs kyis bsgyur ba ji bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /des na 'pho ba'i nyams len la 'bad pa gal che zhing / 'di lta bu'i rnal 'byor la brten nas steng gi lam nas rnam shes mkha' spyod du 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma shin tu dkon te/ mkha' 'gro kun spyod nas/ 'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog ste/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khyer/ /de lta'i rnal 'byor pa dang ni/ /rnal 'byor ma ni sa steng dkon/ zhes so/ /drug pa bar dor 'tshang rgya bar 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor la gsum gyi/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni sngar dang 'dra la/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor ni/ da lta nyid nas bar do sbyang dgos pas 'di ltar nyams su blang ste/

'di ltar thog mar rang shi nas bar dor ming bzhi'i phung por gnas par bsams la/ de'i rjes su a tsa ma nga shi ba yin par 'dug pas bar do 'od gsal mngon du bya dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po dang / bya ba gang dang gang byed pa thams cad bar do'i bya ba yin snyam pa'i 'dun pas bskyed rdzogs gnyis yang gsal gdab cing / khyad par du 'khyer so gsum dang nam du yang mi 'bral bar bya'o/ /de ltar goms pas bar dor sngar bas bdun 'gyur gyis shes pa gsal ba dang / rnam smin gyi lus rgya med pas ye shes bsgom pa shin tu stobs che ba dang / sngar nas rgyun du goms pa'i stobs gsum gyis bar dor rang shi ba la shi bar ngo shes te bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi rnal 'byor dran nas zung 'jug tu 'bad rtsol med par nyams su len par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa nyams su blang ba'i phan yon gnyis kyi mjug bsdu ba ni/ da ltar gyi 'khrul snang la bden par 'dzin pa 'di bskyed rdzogs kyi sgyu ma ltar rang grol du song bas rmi lam gyi bar do chod de de chod pas skye shi bar do las grol nas bskyed rim lha sku sgyu ma lta bu dang / rdzogs rim 'od gsal dbyer med/ dbang po yang rab kyis mngon du gyur te/ zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa des srid pa bar ma do med par mya ngan dang sdug bsngal thams cad las 'das nas 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de'ang dus 'khor rtsa rgyud du/ 'od gsal de la sems 'dzin na/ /nyon mongs dgra yi dpung rnams 'joms/ /zhes dang / 'od gsal ba la rgyun par gnas/ /bar do'i grong khyer de mi mthong / /zhes dang / rim lnga las/ 'das pa dang ni ma 'ongs dang / /da ltar byung ba'i srid pa kun/ /'od gsal bas ni rnam sbyangs pas/ /skad cig de la ma lus mthong / /zhes dang / rim pa gsum pa las/ 'gro kun rang dbang med pa las/ /rang dbang du ni 'gyur ba yin/ /de yi rgyu ni 'od gsal ba/ /'od gsal thams cad stong pa'o/

/sems gang gis ni byis pa rnams/ /'khor ba'i 'ching bas bcings gyur pa/ /sems de nyid kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /bde gshegs gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /der ma grol na srid pa bar do'i lus blangs te bar dor bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug nyams su blangs nas sangs rgyas par the tshom med cing mngal sgo yang des khegs pa yin par gda'/ 'di gang zag dbang po yang rab kyi chos yin pas de phan chod kyi bar do'i chos gsung ba yin skad/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i rnal 'byor pa rtags mi 'dod kyang / kun rdzob tu rtags kyis rnal 'byor pa mi gtong ba yin te/ rdzogs rim bsgoms na ring bsrel/ bskyed rims bsgoms pa la lha sku/ sngags bzlas pa la sgra/ 'od zer spro bsdu bsgoms pa la 'ja' 'od/ byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pa la thugs 'byon par bshad do/ /de dag thams cad bla ma gnyan la byung / nyams su blangs na kun la 'byung gsung ngo / /gdams ngag 'di bla ma gnyan la yi dam gyi lhas gnang zhing thugs nyams su bzhes pa snyan rgyud yi ge med pa'i khrid bya ba dmar yig tu bzhugs pa yin pa las/ dus phyis kun spangs chos rje'i gsung la brten nas bla ma so sos zin bris kyi yi ge ci rigs su mdzad na'ang / mi gsal zhing thun tshags su song nas go dka' ba rnams bdag gzhan dran pa gso ba'i phyir khrid yig ngo sprod dang bcas pa 'di chos rje brag kha bas mdzad pa'i yi ge la gzhi byas te/ gsung sgros mi mthun pa gzhan dang / mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma dang yang sbyar nas shin tu gsal bar bgyis so/ /dpal ldan rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i/ /gsung gi mi rtog rtogs pa'i mdangs gsal ba/ /bla ma'i man ngag rta bdun gyis phye ba'i/ /mnyam rjes zung 'jug chu skyes phreng ba 'di/ /zab mo'i lam nas bde chen gnas 'gro zhing / /lhag bsam dag pa'i nor gyis legs par phyug /bla ma la gus de nyid don la gzhol/

/sgrub brtson don gnyer blo gros mgul rgyan mdzod/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs kyi yid bzhin nor/ /bla med rgyud sde kun gyi snying po'i bcud/ /gzhi dang lam 'bras phyag rgya chen po'i don/ /zab cing rtogs dkar mchog tu gsang ba 'di/ /de nyid ma mthong rnam g.yeng dbang song zhes/ /le lo'i yid kyis sgrub la brtson pa bral/ /chags dang sdang byas mtshan mar 'dzin pa yi/ /byis pa'i blo can bdag blo'i yul min yang / /bla ma'i man ngag mdo rgyud sna tshogs dang / /bstan bcos dri med grub pa'i man ngag mchog /khyad par gsal sgron bzhi dang snying po'i skor/ /rgyal sras 'grel chen ji ltar gsal bar bshad/ /'di la ma bshad nyes bshad ma 'brel dang / /ha cang bshad dang sbas don gsal bshad pa'i/ /bdag blo'i nyes gang bla ma brgyud par bcas/ /lha dang mkhas pa'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /'dir 'bad dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i tshogs/ /mtha' yas srid zhi'i rgud pa las grol nas/ /dpag yas zag med dga' bde'i rin chen gling / /rgyal ba sku bzhi'i rgya mtshor myur 'jug cing / /rang bzhin rnam dag rigs bzang ma las skyes/ /snang stong bzhin mdzes 'od gsal 'dzum bag can/ /bde stong gos gyon zung 'jug rin chen rgyan/ /'od 'bar dra bas mdzes pa'i gzhon nu ma/ /de dang lhan cig deng nas byang chub bar/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad rgyang bsrings te/ zhi lhag zung 'jug mchog gi dga' ston la/ /mchog tu dga' bas rtag tu rol bar shog /gzhan yang 'jig rten pa kun 'tshe bral ba'i/ /lha mi'i bde skyid dpal la longs spyod cing / /kun kyang dam pa'i chos la spyod pa yis/ /'jig rten 'di dag bde bas gang bar shog /kye ho rnyed dka' dal 'byor rin chen 'di/ /legs par rnyed nas snying po mi len zhing / /zab mo'i gdams pa don du mi gnyer ba'i/ /skye bo 'di dag rang gis rang nyid bslus/ /'khor ba'i brtson rar bdud kyi zhags pas bcings/

/'chi ba'i lam zhugs skye ba'i rgyar chud pa'i/ /'gro ba 'di kun rang nyid bder sems pa/ /rang nyid rang gis rmongs par byas pa bzhin/ /nges par 'chi zhing nam 'chi cha med par/ /legs par brtags kyang mi 'chi snyam sems te/ /phyi ma'i sdug bsngal rgyu yi las sogs pa'i/ /skye bo 'di kun mya ngan bya bar 'os/ /rang gis mdo rgyud kun gyi don rtogs shing / /man ngag dang ldan gzhan la ston byed kyang / /da dung 'khor ba'i nyes pas mi skyo ba'i/ /mkhas pa de dag chu shing snying po 'dra/ /rgyal ba'i byang chub rnyed dka' 'thob pa la/ /lus dang longs spyod btang zhes smras bzhin du/ /chos phyir sdug bsngal spu tsam mi bzod pa'i/ /rgyal sras de dag skye bo'i bzhad gad gnas/ /bdag nyid nyams rtogs gdams ngag mi ldan yang / /sna tshogs nor dang thabs kyi blo brid de/ /long ba brgyud pa lta bu'i lam bstan nas/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams bslu bar byed pa mtshar/ /de phyir 'du 'dzi mtha' dag rgyang bsrings te/ /gcig tu phan brtson 'gro ba'i mig gyur zhing / /zab mo'i lam gyis 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /bshes gnyen de dag nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin/ /rang don rgyab phyogs gzhan don sgrub la brtson/ /srog gi ched du'ang gzhan la gnod mi mnga'/ /rang rang skal ba ji bzhin lam bstan nas/ /byang chub rgya cher rgyal sras gang de rmad/ /dang po thos bsam bya ba mthar byas te/ /bar du g.yel ba med par sgrub la brtson/ /tha mar phyag rgya chen po mngon gyur pa'i/ /gang zag de 'dra yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /de phyir bdag la phan 'dod grogs po dag /kha zas dug can lta bu'i mgon spangs nas/ /bshes gnyen dam pa de dag bsten byas te/ /gdams pa'i bcud 'thung rtogs pa'i lus brtas mdzod/ /bdag kyang srog phyir dam chos mi gtong la/ /sna tshogs mdo rgyud don shes man ngag ldan/ /gzhan la gnod spangs gcig tu phan brtson yang /
